{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗数至玄至微，理𣥜易明，雖設問於百篇之中，猶有言而未盡。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061624339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至如星之分野，各有所属，夀夭賢愚，富貴貧賤，不可一槩論議。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061640723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其星分布于十二垣，数定乎三十六位，入庙為竒，失度為虚。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061657107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵以身命為福徳之本，加以根源為窮通之資。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061673491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星有同纒，数有分定，湏明其生尅之要，必詳乎得垣失度之分。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061689875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061706259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174007737712681"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乎紫微舎纒，司一天儀之象，卒列宿而成垣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061706259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𡈽星苟居其垣，若可動移；金星專司財庫，最怕空亡。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061722643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝居動則列宿奔馳；貪守空而財源不聚。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061739027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"各司其職，不可参差。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061755411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苟或不察其機，更忘其變，則数之造化逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061771795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"例曰：禄逢冲破，吉處藏㐫；馬遇空亡，終身奔走。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061788179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢敗地，發也虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061804563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"絶處逢生，花而不敗。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061820947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨庙旺，再觀生尅之機；命坐強宫，細察制化之理。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061837331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月最嫌反背，禄馬最喜交馳，倘居空亡，得失最為要緊，若逢敗地，扶持大有竒功。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061853715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微天府，全依輔弼之功；七殺破軍，專依羊鈴之虐。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061870099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星吉，逢㐫也吉，諸星㐫，逢吉也㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061886483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼夾帝為上品，桃花犯主為至滛。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061902867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶會，材擅經邦；魁鉞同行，位居台輔。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061919251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061935635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174007737876521"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文拱命，貴而且賢；日月夾財，不權則冨；馬頭𢃄箭，鎮衞邉疆；刑囚夾印，刑杖惟司；善䕃朝綱，仁慈之長。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061935635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴入貴郷，逢者富貴；財居財位，遇者冨奢。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061952019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽居午，謂之日麗中天，有專榷之貴，敵國之冨。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061968403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂居子，號曰水澄桂蕚，得淸要之職，忠諫之材。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568061984787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微輔弼同宫，一呼百諾，居上品。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062001171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文耗居寅卯，謂之衆水朝東。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062017555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月守不如照合，䕃福聚，不怕㐫危。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062033939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪居亥子，名為泛水桃花；刑遇貪狼，號曰風流彩杖。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062050323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺𤎉貞同位，路上埋屍；破軍暗矅同鄉，水中作塚。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062066707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄居奴僕，縱有官也奔馳；帝遇㐫徒，雖獲吉而無道。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062083091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝坐金車，則曰金轝捧節；福安文曜，謂之玉袖天香。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062099475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽會文昌於官禄，皇殿朝班，冨貴全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062115859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂㑹","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062132243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174059281416233"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲於妻宫，蟾宫折桂，文章令盛；禄存守於田財，堆金積玉，財䕃坐於遷移，巨啇高賈。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062132243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗居禄位，沿途乞食；貪會旺宫，終身鼠𥨸；殺居絶地，天年夭似顔回；貪坐生郷，夀考永如彭祖。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062148627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌暗同居身命，疾厄沉困、弱羸。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062165011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫星㑹於父母、遷移，刑傷産室；刑殺同𤎉貞於官禄，枷杻難逃；官府加刑殺於遷移，離郷遭配。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062181395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善福守於空位，天竺生涯；輔弼单守命宫，離宗庶出。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062197779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺臨於身命，加𢙣殺，必定死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062214163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊鈴合於命宫，遇白虎湏當刑戮；官府發於吉曜，流殺怕逢破軍；羊鈴慿太嵗以引行。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062230547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病符官符皆作禍，奏書愽士與流禄盡作吉祥；力士将軍同青龍顕其權勢。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062246931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童子限如水上泡漚，老人限似風中燃燭。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062263315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇殺","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062279699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174059281514537"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與擎羊，流年最忌。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062279699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生荣辱，限元必有休咎；處世孤貧，数位定逢駁雜；學者至此，誠玄㣲矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062296083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"原夫紫㣲帝座，生爲厚重之容；天府尊星，當主純和之體。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062312467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金烏圓滿，玉兔清竒，天機為不長不短之姿，情懷好善。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062328851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲乃至剛至毅之操，心性果决，天同肥滿，目秀清竒，𤎉貞眉寛口濶靣横，為人性暴，好忿，好争。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062345235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼為善𢙣之星，入庙必應長聳，出垣必定頑嚚。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062361619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門乃是非之曜，在廟敦厚温良，天相精神相貌持重，天梁𥡷重，心事玉潔氷淸。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062378003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺如子路，暴虎馮河。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062394387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鈴似豫讓，吞炭装啞，暴虎馮河兮目大㐫狼，吞炭装啞","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062410771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174059281612841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"兮暗狼聲沉俊雅。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062410771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌，眉淸目秀、磊落；文曲，口舌便侫，在廟定生異痣，失陷必有班痕。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062427155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左輔右弼，温良規模，端莊高士。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062443539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天魁天鉞，具足威儀；重合三台，則十全模範。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062459923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊陀羅，形醜貌麄，有矯詐躰態。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062476307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍不仁，背厚眉寛，行坐腰斜、奸詐、好行驚險。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062492691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性貌如春和藹，乃是禄存之情徳；情懷似火烽衝，此誠破耗之威權。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062509075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星論廟旺，最怕空亡；殺落空亡，竟無威力。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062525459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權禄克九竅之竒，耗刼散平生之福。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062541843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢梁隂抱私財，益與他人；耗遇貪狼，凄滛情於井底，貪星入於馬垣，易善易悪，惡曜扶同善曜禀性不常。","logicSentenceId":"7587040568062558227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財居空亡，巴三覽四，文曲旺宫，聞一知十。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070516777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"暗合𤎉貞，為貪濫之曹吏；身命司数，寔奸盗之技児，猪屠之流；","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070533161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174059281678377"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善祿定是竒高之藝，細巧伶俐之人。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070533161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男居生旺，最要得纁，女居死絶，專㸔福徳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070549545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命最嫌立於敗位，財源却怕逢空亡，機刑殺䕃狐星論，嗣續之宫，加惡星忌耗，不為竒特；陀忌耗囚之星，守父母之纒，决然破祖，刑傷兼之；童格冝相，根基要察。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070565929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微肥滿，天府精神。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070582313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存禄主，也應厚重；日月曲相同梁機昌，皆為羙俊之姿，乃是清竒之格，上長下短，自秀眉清。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070598697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼同武曲，形小聲高而量大；天同加陀忌，肥滿而目渺，擎羊身察遭傷，若遇火鈴巨暗，必生異病。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070615081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又值耗殺，定主形醜貌麄。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070631465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居死絶之限，童子乳哺，徒劳其力，老者亦然夀終。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070647849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此数中之綱領，乃為星緯之機關。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070664233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玩味專精，以恭玄妙。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070680617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限有高低，星尋","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070697001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174113597718539"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜怒。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070697001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如運限駁雜，終有浮沉。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070713385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢殺地，更要推詳；倘遇空亡，必湏細察。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070729769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"精研於此，不患不神。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070746153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲帝座，以輔弼為佐貳，作数中之主星，乃有用之源流。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070762537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是以南北二斗，集而成数，為萬物之靈。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070778921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖以水淘溶，則隂陽既濟，水盛陽傷，火盛隂滅，二者不可偏廢，故得其中者，斯為羙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070795305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅乃木之垣，乃三陽交泰之時，草木萌芽之所，至於卯位，其木愈旺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070811689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼天機是庙樂，故得天相水到寅爲之旺相；巨門水得卯為之䟽通。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070828073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"木乃土栽培，加以水之澆灌三方，更得文曲水、破軍水相會尤妙，又加禄存土，極羙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070844457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門水到","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070860841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174113597833227"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑，天梁土到未，陀羅金到於四墓之所，苟或得擎羊金相㑹，以土為金墓，則金通不凝。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070860841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加以天府土天同金以生之，是為金趂𡈽肥順其徳以生成，未巳午乃火位，巳為水土所絶之地更午垣之火餘，氣流於巳，水則倒流，火氣逆熖，必歸于巳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070877225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午属火德，能生於巳絶之土，所以𤎉貞木居焉。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070893609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於午火旺照離。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070909993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明，洞徹表裏，而文曲水入庙，若㑹紫府，則魁星拱斗，加以天機木，貪狼火，謂之變景，愈加竒特。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070926377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"申酉金乃西方太白之氣，武居申而好生，擎羊在酉而用殺，加以巨門禄存陀羅而𦔳之愈急，湏得逆行，逢善化悪，是為妙用。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070942761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亥水属文曲破軍之庙地，乃文明清高之士，萬里𣲖源之絜，如大川之澤，不","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070959145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174113597931531"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲焦枯；居於亥位，將入天河，是故為妙。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070959145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍水於子旺之鄉，如巨海之浪淜洶湧，可遠覌而不可近𠋣，破軍是以居焉。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070975529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四墓之尅，充其㳽漫，必得武曲之金，使其源流不絶，方為妙矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768070991913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其餘諸星，以身命推之，無施不可，至玄至妙者矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071008297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"斗数凖繩","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命居生旺，定冨貴各有其冝；身坐空亡，論荣枯專求其要。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071024681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微帝座在南極，不能施功；天府令星在南地，専能為福。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071041065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機七殺同宫，也善三分；太隂火鈴同位，反成十𢙣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071057449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼為善宿，入廟不㐫；巨門為𢙣曜，得垣尢羙。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071073833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸㐫在𦂳要之鄉，最冝制，擎羊在身命之位，却受孤单。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071090217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見殺星倒限最㐫，福䕃臨之，","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071106601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174195852247051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庶幾可解。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071106601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵在人之機變，更加作意之推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071122985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辨生尅制化以定窮通；看好𢙣正偏以言禍福。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071139369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官星居於福地，近貴营財；福星居於官宫，却成無成。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071155753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命得星為要，限度遇吉為荣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071172137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若言子媳有無，專在擎羊。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071188521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗殺逢之則害，妻妾亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071204905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相貌逢㐫，必𢃄破相；疾厄逢忌，定有尫羸。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071221289","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏言定数以求玄，更在同年之相合。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071237673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緫為綱頌，用作凖繩。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071254057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"斗数發㣲論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"白玉","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蟾先生曰：覌天斗数，與五星不同。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071270441","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"按此星辰與諸術大異。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071286825","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四正吉星定為貴，三方殺拱少為竒。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071303209","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對照兮詳㐫詳吉，合照兮覌賤視荣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071319593","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉星入垣則為吉，㐫星失地則為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071335977","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢紫","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071352361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174195852361739"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府，非特壽而且荣；身遇殺星，不但貧而且賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071352361","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右會於紫府，極品之尊；科權陷於㐫郷，功名𬧙蹬；行限逢乎弱地，未必為災；立命會在強宫，必能降福。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071368745","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀七殺，限運莫逢，逢之定有刑傷；","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071385129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼空傷使，在内，合断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天哭䘮門，流年莫遇，遇之寔防破害。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071385129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南斗主限必生男，北斗加臨，先得女。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071401513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科星居於陷地，燈火辛勤；昌曲在㐫郷，林泉冷淡，奸謀頻設。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071417897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲愧遇破軍；滛奔大行，紅鵉羞逢貪宿。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071434281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命身相尅，則心亂而不閑；玄媪","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071450665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"即天姚星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三宫，則邪滛而躭酒。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071450665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺臨三位，定然妻子不和；巨到二宫，必是兄弟無義；刑殺守子宮，子難奉老；諸㐫照財帛，聚散無常。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071467049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀疾厄，眼目昏肓；火鈴到遷移，長途寂寞。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071483433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尊星列賤位，主人多劳；悪星","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071499817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174249518252051"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應八宫，奴僕有𦔳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071499817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄遇紫府，富而且貴；田宅遇破軍，先破後成；福徳遇空刼，奔走無力；相貌加刑殺，刑尅難免。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071516201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後學者執此推詳，萬無一失。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071532585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"重補斗数彀率","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星吉多逢㐫也吉，諸悪星多逢吉也㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071548969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星更緾度，数分定局，重在看星得垣受制，方可論人禍福竆通。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071565353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大槩以身命為禍福之柄，以根源為竆通之機。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071581737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微在命，輔弼同垣，其貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071598121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財印夾命，日月夾財，其冨何疑。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071614505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䕃福臨不怕㐫冲；日月㑹不如合照。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071630889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼居子，乃為泛水桃花；天刑遇貪，必主風流刑杖。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071647273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微坐命庫，則曰金舉捧御輦；臨官安文曜，號為衣錦惹","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071663657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174249518383123"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天杳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071663657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂合文曲於妻宮，翰林清異；太陽會文昌於官禄，金殿傳臚。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071680041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄合守田財，為爛糓堆金；財䕃居遷移，為高商豪客。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071696425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗居敗地，沿途丐求；貪㑹旺宮，終身𠂦竊；殺居絶地，生成三十二之顔回，日在旺宮，可學八百年之彭祖。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071712809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨暗同垣於身命，疾厄羸瘦其軀；㐫星交會於相貌遷移，傷刑其面。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071729193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大耗㑹𤎉貞於官禄，枷杻囚徒；官符㑹刑殺於遷移，離卿逺配；七殺臨於陷地，流羊必見死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071745577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗殺忌逢破軍，火鈴嫌逢太歳。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071761961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書愽士，並官禄以長乎吉祥；力士将軍與靑龍以顯其威福。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071778345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童子限弱，水上浮泡；老人限衰，風中燃燭。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071794729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇殺必驚，流年最緊。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071811113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生發逹，限元最怕浮沉，一世沌澶，命限逢乎駁雜。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071827497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論而","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071843881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174249518481427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至此，𠃔矣玄微。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071843881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"前後两凶神","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"謂：两鄰加侮，尚可撑持；同室與謀，最難隄防。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071860265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"片火焚天馬，重羊逐禄存，刼空親戚無常，權禄行藏靡定。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071876649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子哉魁鉞，小人也羊鈴，㐫不皆㐫，吉無純吉，主強賔弱，可保無虞，主弱賔強，㐫危立。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071893033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見，主賔得失両相冝。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071909417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運限命身當互見，身命最嫌羊陀七。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071925801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺遇之未免爲㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071942185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限甚忌貪破巨𤎉，逢之，定然作禍，命遇魁昌。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071958569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"常得貴，限逢紫府定財多。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071974953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢視女人之命先覌夫子二宮，若值殺星，定三嫁而心不足。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768071991337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或逢羊孛，雖啼哭而淚不乾。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072007721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若覌男命，始以福財為主，再審遷移何如。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072024105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174316752945164"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限相因吉㐫同。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072040489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"断限逢吉曜，平生動用和諧；命坐㐫郷，一世求謀齟齬。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072056873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉禄臨身，女得純隂貞絜之徳；同梁守命，男得純陽中正之心。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072073257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子命中亦有羊陀火鈴，小人命内豈無科禄權星，要看得垣失垣，專論入廟失廟。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072089641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若論小児，詳推童限。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072106025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小児命坐㐫郷，三五歳必然殀析；更有限逢惡殺，五七歳必主災亡。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072122409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌文曲天魁秀，不讀詩書也可，人多學少成，只為擎羊逢刼殺爲人。","logicSentenceId":"7587040768072138793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"好訟。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034756947987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖因太歳遇官符，命之理微，熟察星辰之變化数之理，逺細詳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034756964371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"格局之興衰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034756980755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北極加㐫殺，為道爲僧羊陀遇惡星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034756997139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為奴爲僕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757013523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如武破𤎉貪，固深謀而貴題。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757029907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757046291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊佗空刼反小志以孤寒限輔。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757062675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星旺限，雖弱而不弱。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757079059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命臨吉地，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757095443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174316753043468"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命雖㐫而不㐫断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757095443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"橋截空大小難行。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757111827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯酉二空，聦明發福，命身遇紫府叠。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757128211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"積金銀，二主逢刼空，衣食不足，謀而不遂。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757144595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命限遇入擎羊，東作西成。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757160979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限身遭逢輔、相、科、權、禄拱，定為板桂之高人；空刼羊鈴，作九流之術士。","logicSentenceId":"7599598089904586752","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"情懐暢舒，昌曲命身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757210131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詭詐浮虚，羊陀陷地。","logicSentenceId":"7599598089904603136","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天機、天梁、擎羊㑹，早有刑而晚見孤。","logicSentenceId":"7599598089904619520","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼、武曲、𤎉貞逢，少受貧而後享福。","logicSentenceId":"7599598089904635904","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此皆斗数之奥妙，學者冝熟思之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757226515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"諸星問荅論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：紫微所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757242899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：紫微属土，廼中天之尊星，為帝座，主掌造化樞機。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757259283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生主宰，仗五行，育萬物，以人命為之，立定數安星緾各根所司處年数内，常掌爵禄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757275667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸宫降福，能消百","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757292051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174316753190924"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惡，湏看三台。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757292051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖紫微守命是中台，前一位是上台，後一位是下台，俱看在廟旺之卿否，有何吉㐫之守照。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757308435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如廟旺化吉甚妙，䧟又化㐫甚㐫，吉限不為羙，凶限則㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757324819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之身命，若值禄存同宫，日月三合相照，貴不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757341203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無輔弼同行，則爲孤君，雖羙玉不足。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757357587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更與諸殺同宮，或諸吉合照，則君子在野，小人在位，主人奸詐假義，平生惡積。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757373971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與囚同居，無左右相佐，定為胥吏。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757390355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如落疾厄、兄弟、奴僕相貌四陷宫，主人劳碌，作事無成，雖得相助，亦不為福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757406739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更冝詳細宫度，應究星纒之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757423123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居官禄身命三官，最要左右守衞。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757439507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天相禄馬交馳，不落空亡，更坐生郷，可為貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757455891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如魁鉞三台星㑹吉星，則三台八座矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757472275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝會","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757488659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174371857760297"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌拱照，又得羙限扶，必文選之職。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757488659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝降七殺為權，有吉同位，則帝相有氣，諸吉咸集，作武官之職。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757505043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財帛田宅，有左右守衞。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757521427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又與太隂、武曲同度，不見惡星，必為財賦之官。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757537811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更與武曲、禄存同宫，身命中尤為竒特。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757554195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女宫得祥佐吉星，主生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757570579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨守無相佐，則子息孤单。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757586963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫會吉，男女得貴羙，夫婦諧老，亦要無破殺。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757603347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移雖是強宫，更要相佐，有吉星照，命則因人之貴，福徳，男為䧟地，女為廟樂，逢吉則吉，逢㐫則凶。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757619731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：紫㣲為帝座，在諸宫，能降福消灾，觧諸星之惡虗，能制火鈴為善，能降七殺為權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757636115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得府相、左右、昌曲吉集，無有不貴，不然亦主巨冨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757652499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱有四殺冲破，亦作中局。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757668883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇破","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757685267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174371857907753"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍，在辰戌丑未，主為臣不忠，為子不孝之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757685267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之，作貴婦断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757701651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加殺冲破，亦作平常，不為下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757718035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：紫微原属土，官祿宫主星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757734419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有相為有用，無相為孤君。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757750803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸宮皆降福，逢㐫福自申。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757767187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌發科甲，文曲受皇恩。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757783571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道有師號，快樂度春秋。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757799955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衆星皆拱照，爲吏恊公平。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757816339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人㑹帝座，遇吉事貴人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757832723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與桃花㑹，飄蕩落風塵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757849107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊火鈴聚，用𥨸狗偷群。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757865491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方有吉拱，方作貴人評。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757881875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還無輔弼，諸𢙣共欺凌。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757898259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝為無道主，考究要知因。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757914643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限若遇帝，喜氣自然新。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757931027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉蟾先生曰：紫微乃中天星主，為衆星之樞紐，為造化之根","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757947411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174371858006057"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"柢，為人命之主宰，掌五行，育萬物，各有所司。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757947411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以左輔、右弼為相，以天相、昌曲為從，以魁鉞為傳令，以日月為分司，以禄馬爲掌爵之司，以天府為帑藏之主。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757963795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命逢之，不勝其吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757980179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如遇四殺","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757996563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羊陀火鈴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刼空，機梁冲破，定是僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034757996563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星在命，爲人厚重，面紫色，専作吉断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758012947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天機所主如何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758029331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天機属木，南斗第三益筭之善星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758045715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後化氣曰：善得地合之行事，觧諸星之順逆定数。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758062099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於人命，逢諸吉咸集，則萬事皆善。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758078483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"勤於禮佛，敬乎六親，利於林泉，冝於僧道，無惡虐不仁之心，有靈機應變之志。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758094867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"淵魚察見，作事有方。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758111251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之為福，逢吉爲吉，遇㐫為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758127635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或守於身，更逢天","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758144019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174419656065060"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁，必有高藝隨身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758144019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"習者冝詳玩之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758160403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：天機益夀之星，若守身命，主人異常。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758176787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與天梁左右，昌曲交㑹，文為清題，武為忠良。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758193171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居陷地，四殺冲破，是為下局。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758209555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若見七殺天梁，當爲僧道之淸閑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758225939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢人二限逢之，興家創業更攺。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758242323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人吉星拱照，主旺夫益子，有權禄則為貴婦，落局羊陀火忌冲破，主下賤殘疾刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758258707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天機兄弟，主南斗正曜星，作事有操畧，禀性最高明，所為最好尚，亦可作群英，㑹吉主享福，入格居翰林。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758275091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門同一位，武職壓邉庭，亦要權逢殺，方可立功名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758291475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天梁星同位，定作道與","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758307859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174419656196132"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧，女人若逢此，性巧必滛奔。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758307859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天同與昌曲，聚拱主華荣，辰戍子午地，入廟有功名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758324243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在寅卯辰，七殺并破軍，血光災不測，羊陀及火鈴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758340627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與諸殺㑹，災患有虛驚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758357011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武暗𤎉破㑹，両目少光明。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758373395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限臨此宿，事必有變更。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758389779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉蟾先生曰：天機，南斗善星，故化氣曰善，佐帝令以行事，解諸㐫之逆節定教。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758406163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於人命之中，若逢吉聚，則為富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758422547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢殺冲亦必好善，孝義六親，勤於禮佛，無不仁不義之為，有靈通變逹之志。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758438931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之，多主福壽。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758455315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其在廟旺有力，䧟地無力。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758471699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問太陽所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758488083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：太陽星属火，日之精也，乃造化之表儀。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758504467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在数，主人有貴氣，能為文為武。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758520851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸吉集則降禎祥，處黒","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758537235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174464988053515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星則劳心費力。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758537235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若隨身命之中，居於庙樂之地，爲数中之至曜，乃官禄之樞機，後化貴化禄，最冝在官禄宮，男作父星，女為夫主。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758553619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命逢諸吉守照，更得太隂同照，富貴全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034758570003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身居之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882777129","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢吉聚，則可在貴人門下客，否則公卿走卒，夫妻亦為弱宫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882793513","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男爲諸吉聚，可因妻得貴，䧟地加殺，傷妻不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882809897","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女宫得八座加吉星，在庙旺地，主生貴子，權柄不小。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882826281","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若財帛宫於旺地㑹吉相助，不怕巨門緾，其富貴綿逺矣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882842665","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若旺相無空刼，一生主冨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882859049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居田宅，得祖父䕃澤；若左右諸吉星皆至，大小二限俱到，必有驟興之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882875433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若限不扶，不可以三合論議，恐應小差。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882891817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之，限旺亦可共享。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882908201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與鈴刑忌集限，目下有憂，或主尅父。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882924585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174464988151819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與刑殺聚限，有傷官之憂，常人有官非之撓。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882940969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與羊陀聚，則有疾病；與火鈴合，其苦楚不少。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882957353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推而至此，禍福瞭然。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882973737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遷移宫，其福與身命不同，難招祖業，移根換棄，出租爲家，限歩逢之，决要動移，女命逢之不及。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034882990121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若福徳宮有相佐夫，招賢明之夫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883006505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"父毋宫男子单作父星，有輝則吉，無輝尅父。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883022889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：太陽星周天曆度，輪轉無竆，喜輔弼而佐君，象以禄存而助福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883039273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所忌者巨暗遭逢，所樂者太隂相旺，諸宫㑹吉則吉，黒道遇之則劳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883055657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守人身命，主人忠鯁，不較是非。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883072041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居廟旺，化禄化權，允為貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883088425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得左右昌曲、魁鉞三合拱照財官二宫，富貴極品。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883104809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加四殺，亦主飽煖，僧道有師號。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883121193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人庙旺，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883137577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174464988282891"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主旺夫益子，加權禄封贈，加殺主平常。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883137577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：太陽原属火，正主官禄星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883153961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居身命位，禀性最聦明。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883170345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"慈愛量寛大，福夀享遐齡。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883186729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與太隂㑹，驟發貴無倫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883203113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有輝照身命，平步入金門。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883219497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門不相犯，升殿承君恩。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883235881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"偏垣逢暗度，貧賤不可言。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883252265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男人必尅父，女命夫不全。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883268649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火䍅逢苦定，羊陀眼目昏，二限若值此，必定賣田園。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883285033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉蟾先生曰：太陽司權貴為文，遇天刑為武。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883301417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅卯爲初昇，在辰巳為昇殿，在午爲曰麗中天，主大冨貴，在未申爲偏垣，作事先勤後惰，在酉為西没，貴而不顕，秀而不實；在戍亥子","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883317801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174512002056203"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為失輝，更逢臣暗破軍，一生劳碌貧忙，更主眼目有傷，與人寡合招非。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883317801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命逢之，夫星不美，遇耗則非禮成婚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883334185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與禄存同宫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883350569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖主財帛亦辛苦不閑，若與帝星左右同宫，則爲貴論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883366953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又嫌火鈴刑忌，未免先尅其父。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883383337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星男得之為父星，女得之為夫星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883399721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：武曲星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883416105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：武曲北斗第六星，属金，乃財帛宫，主財，與天府同宫有夀，其施權於十二宫，分其臨地有庙旺陥宫，主於人性切果决，有喜有怒，可福可災。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883432489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若耗囚㑹於震宫，必為破祖，淹晋之軰與。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883448873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬交馳，發財於逺郡；若貪狼同度，慳吝之人；破軍同財，郷財到手而成空。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883465257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸㐫聚而作禍，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883481641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174512002154507"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉集以成祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883481641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：武曲属金，在天司寿，在数司財，怕受制入陥，喜禄存而同政，與太隂以互權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883498025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天府、天梁為佐貳之星，財帛田宅為專司之所。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883514409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"悪殺耗囚㑹於震宫，必見木壓雷驚，破軍；貪狼㑹於坎宫，必主投河溺水。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883530793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹禄馬則發財遠郡；貪狼㑹則少年不利。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883547177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所謂武曲守命福非輕，貪狼不發少年人是也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883563561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庙樂桃花同度，利已損人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883579945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺火星同宫，因財被刼，遇羊陀則孤尅，遇破軍難顯貴，单居二限可也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883596329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與破軍同位，更臨二限之中，定主是非之撓。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883612713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖武曲守命，主人剛強果断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883629097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲巳生人福厚，出将入相，更得貪火冲破，定為貴格。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883645481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜西北生人東","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883661865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174565189943350"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"南生人，平常不守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祖業，四殺冲破，孤貧不一，破相延年，女人吉多，爲貴婦。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883661865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加殺冲破，孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883678249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問天同星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883694633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天同星属水、金，南斗第四星也，為福徳宫之主宰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883711017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"後云：化福，最喜遇吉矅，𦔳福添祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883727401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲人𤎉潔，貌禀淸竒。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883743785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有機謀，無亢激，不怕七殺相侵，不怕諸殺同纒。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883760169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限若逢之，一生得地，十二宫中皆曰福，無破定為祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883776553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：天同、南斗益筭保生之星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883792937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化禄爲善，逢吉為祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883809321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命值之，主為人謙遜，禀性温和，心慈鯁直，文墨精通，有竒志，無㐫激。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883825705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不忌七殺相侵，不畏諸㐫同度，十二宮中皆爲福論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883842089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇左右、昌、梁貴顯。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883858473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜壬、乙生人，巳、亥得地，不冝六庚生人，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883874857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174565190058038"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居酉地終身不守，㑹四殺，居巳亥為陷，殘疾孤尅。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883874857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人逢殺冲破，刑夫尅子；梁月冲破，合作偏房，僧道冝之，主享福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883907625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：亷貞所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883940393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：𤎉貞属木，北斗第五星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883956777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在斗司品秩，在数司權令，不臨庙旺，更犯官符，故曰化囚為殺，觸之不可觧其禍，逢之不可測其祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883973161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人心狼性狂，不習禮義。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034883989545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢帝座執威權，遇禄存主冨貴，遇文昌好禮樂，遇殺曜顕武職。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884005929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在官禄有威權，在身命為次桃花。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884022313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居旺宮，則賭賻迷花而致訟；與巨門交會於䧟地，則是非起於官司。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884038697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢財星耗合，祖業必破；遇刑忌則膿血不免；遇白虎則刑杖難逃；遇武曲於受制之郷，恐木壓蛇傷；同火曜於陷空之地，主投河自縊。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884055081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884071465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174565190221878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍與日月以濟行，目疾而不免。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884071465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢至此，災不可攘。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884087849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只冝官禄身命之位，遇吉福應，逢㐫則不慈。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884104233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在他宫，禍福冝詳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884120617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：㢘貪已亥宫，遇吉福盈豐。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884137001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"應過三旬後，湏防不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884153385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天府所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884169769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天府属土，南斗主令第一星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884186153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為財帛之主宰，在斗司福權之宿，會吉皆為冨貴之基，定作荣昌之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884202537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：天府乃南斗延夀觧厄之星，又曰：司命上相鎮國之星，在斗司權，在数則職掌財帛田宅衣禄之神，為帝之佐貳，能制羊陀爲從，能化火鈴爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884218921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人相貌清竒，禀性温","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884235305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174610547195945"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"良端雅，與太陽昌曲㑹，必登首選；逢禄存武曲，必有巨萬之冨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884235305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘云：天府為禄庫，命逢終是冨是也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884251689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不喜四殺冲破，雖無宫貴，亦主財田冨足。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884268073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以田宅財為廟樂，以奴僕相貌為䧟弱，以兄弟為平。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884284457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命逢之，得相佐，主夫妻子女不缺。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884300841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值空亡，是為孤立，不可一例而摧断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884317225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大柢此星多主吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884333609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：此星不論諸宫皆吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884349993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命得之，清正機巧，旺夫益子，雖見冲破，亦以善論，僧道宜之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884366377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有師號","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884382761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天府為禄庫，入命終是冨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034884399145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"萬頃置田庄，家資無論数。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895360041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命坐香閨，男人食天禄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895376425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此是福吉星，四外無不足。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895392809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174610547310633"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：太隂星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895409193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：太隂乃水之精，為田宅主，化冨與日為配天儀表，有上弦、下弦之用。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895425577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"黄到黒到，分勢，尚好𧇊，数定庙樂。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895441961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其為人也聦明俊秀，其禀性也端雅純祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895458345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上弦為要之機，下弦减威之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895474729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所值不以，所見無妨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895491113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若相生坐於太陽，日在卯，月在酉，俱為旺地，為冨貴之基。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895507497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐銀輝之宫，諸吉咸集，爲享福之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895523881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若居䧟地，則落弱之名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895540265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若上弦、下弦，仍可不逢巨門為佳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895556649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身若居之，則有隨娘継拜，或離祖過房。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895573033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命若見悪殺交冲，必作傷残之論，除非僧道，反獲禎祥，决禍福，最為要𦂳，不可参差。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895589417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又或與文曲同居身命，定是九流術士。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895605801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男為妻宿，又作母星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895622185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174662875283497"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：太隂化禄，與日為配，以卯辰、巳午未為䧟地，以酉戍亥子丑為得垣，酉為西出之門，為東潜之所，嫌巨曜以來緾，怕羊陀以同度。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895638569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉囚相犯，七殺相冲，恐非得意之垣，定作傷殘之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895654953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星属水，為田宅宫，主有輝為福，失䧟必㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895671337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女得之，皆為母星，又作妻宿。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895687721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在身命庙樂吉集，主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895704105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在疾厄，遇陀暗，為目疾；遇火鈴為災，值貪殺損目，在父母，如䧟地失輝，遇流年白虎、太嵗，主毋有災。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895720489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此雖純和之星，但失輝受制則不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895736873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢白虎，䘮門吊客，凄亦慎之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895753257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：貪狼所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895769641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：貪狼，北斗觧厄之神，第一星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895786025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"属水，化氣，為桃花，為標凖，乃主禍福之神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895802409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"受善惡，定奸詐瞞人，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895818793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174662875398185"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"授學神仙之術，又好高吟浮蕩，作巧成拙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895818793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入庙樂之宫，可為祥可為禍。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895835177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹破軍，迷花恋酒而䘮命同禄存可吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895851561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇耗囚以虚花，遇𤎉貞也不㓗。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895867945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見七殺，或配以遭刑，遇羊陀，主痔疾，逢刑忌，有班痕，怕二限，為禍非輕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895884329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與七殺同守身命，男有穿窬之躰，女有偷香之態，諸吉壓，不能為福，衆㐫聚，愈長其奸。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895900713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895917097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"事藏","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機虚花無實，與人交厚者簿，而簿者又厚，故云：七殺守身終是夭，貪狼入庙必為娼。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895917097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若身命與破軍同居，更居三合之郷、生旺之地，男好飲而好賭賻、逰蕩，女無媒而自嫁、滛奔、私竊。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895933481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輕則隨客奔馳，重則遊於歌妓。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895949865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜見空亡，返主端正。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895966249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895982633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與武曲同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"度為人謟侫奸貪，每存肥已之心，並無濟人之意。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895982633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174662875529257"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與貞同，公庭必定遭刑；七殺同，定為屠宰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034895999017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀交併，必作風流之鬼。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896015401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲同度，必多虚而少實。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896031785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與七殺日月同纒，男女滛邪，虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896048169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門交戰，口舌是非常有。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896064553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若犯帝座無制，便為無益之人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896080937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得輔弼、昌曲夾制，則無此論。","logicSentenceId":"7619241901221773358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟地逢生，又生祥瑞，雖家顛也發一時之財。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896113705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟㑹火鈴，冨貴全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896130089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在財帛與武曲、太隂同，終非所自發，則為滛供。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896146473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在兄弟子息俱為陷地，在田宅則破蕩祖業，先冨後貧。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896162857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奴僕居於庙旺，必因奴僕所破。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896179241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫妻宫男女俱不得羙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896195625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄與羊陀暗殺交併，酒色之病迁移。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896212009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐土郷破軍暗殺，併流年嵗殺叠併，則主遭兵火賊盗相侵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896228393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緫而言之，男女非得地之星不見尢妙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896244777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174709775990847"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"希夷先生曰：","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼爲北斗觧厄之神，陽明之星，其氣属木躰，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896261161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"属水。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"故化氣為桃花，乃主禍福之神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896261161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在数則樂為放蕩之事，遇吉則主冨貴，遇㐫則主虚浮。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896277545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人矮小，性剛猛威，机深謀逺，隨波逐浪，愛憎難定。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896293929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居庙旺，遇火星，武職權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896310313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊已生人合局，遇軍相延夀，會𤎉武巧藝，得禄存僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896326697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺破相冲，飄蓬度日，女人主刑尅不㓗，遇太隂則主滛佚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896343081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：巨門所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896375849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：巨門属水金，北斗第二星也，爲隂精之星，化氣為暗，在身命一生招口舌之非；在兄弟則骨肉参商，任夫妻主於隔角，生離死别，縱夫妻有對，不免汚名失節；在子息損後方招，雖有而無。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896392233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在財帛有争競之撓；在疾厄","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896408617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174709776171071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇刑忌眼目之災。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896408617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺臨主殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896425001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在遷移則招是非，在奴僕則多怨逆；在官祿主招刑杖，在田宅則破蕩祖業，在福徳其禍稍輕，在父母則𮞸棄擲。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896441385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
