{"lines":[{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：巨門在天司品萬物，在数則掌執是非，主於暗昧，疑是多非，欺瞞天地，進退両難。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896457769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其性則靣是背非，六親寡合，交人初善終𢙣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896474153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫中，若無庙樂照臨，到處為灾奔波。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896490537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"劳碌至亥子丑、寅巳申維，冨貴亦不耐乆。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896506921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會太陽則吉㐫相半，逢七殺則主殺傷，貪耗同行，因好徒配，遇帝座則制其强，逢禄存則觧其厄，值羊陀男盗女娼。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896523305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"對宫遇火鈴、白虎、無帝座禄存，决配千里；三合殺凑，必遭火厄。","logicSentenceId":"7619241901221789742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃孤獨之宿，刻剥","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896539689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174709776302143"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之神，除為僧道九流，方免劳神偃蹇。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896539689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限逢㐫曜，災難不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896556073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天相星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896572457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天相属水，南斗第五星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896588841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為司爵之宿，爲福善，化氣曰印，是為官禄文星，佐帝之位。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896605225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若人命逢之，言語誠實，事不虚爲，見人難有惻憶之心，見人𢙣抱不平之氣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896621609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官禄得之則顕荣，帝座合之則五權，雖佐日月之光，兼化𤎉貞之悪。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896637993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命得之而荣耀，子息得之而嗣續昌。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896654377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宮中，皆爲祥福，不隨悪而變志，不因殺而攺移，限步逢之，冨不可量。","logicSentenceId":"7619242148411473929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星若臨生狂之郷，雖不逢帝座，若得左右，則職其威權，或居閑弱之地也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896670761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作吉利二限逢之，主富贵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896687145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：天相，南斗司爵之星，化氣爲印，主人衣食豐足，","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896703529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174764830523404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲左右加㑹，位至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896703529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"䧟地貪𤎉、武破，羊陀殺凑，巧藝安身，火鈴冲破殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896719913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人主聰明端莊，志過丈天。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896736297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方吉拱封贈論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896752681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若昌曲冲破，侍妾，在僧道主清高。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896769065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天相原属水，化印主官禄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896785449","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命両官蓬，定主多財福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896801833","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形躰又肥滿，語言不輕凟。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896818217","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出仕主飛騰，居家主財谷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896834601","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限若逢之，有事皆充足。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896850985","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天梁星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896867369","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：天梁属土，南斗第二星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896883753","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"司夀化氣，為䕃爲福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896900137","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夀乃父毋之主，宰殺帝之權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896916521","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於人命則性情磊落，於相貌則厚重温謙循直無私，臨事果决，䕃於身命，福","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896932905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174764830638092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及子孫遇昌曲於財官，逢太陽於福徳","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896932905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p9-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofbuw6/1-1711800585157.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=j1j8kgdEIaFLBUbb86SkwR1CnAw%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofbuw6/1-1711800585157.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7587041034896932905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合，乃為萬今，聲名題於王室，職位臨於風憲。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896932905","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢耗矔，更逢天機及殺，冝僧道，亦受王冡制誥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896965673","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢貪狼同度，而亂礼亂家，居奴僕疾厄，相貌作豐除之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041034896982057","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見童貞刑忌，必無灾厄克激之虞；遇火鈴刑暗，亦無征戦之橈。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035318984758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歳冲而爲福，白虎臨而無殃。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319001142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論而至此，数决竆通之論也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319017526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命或對宫，有天梁，主有夀，乃極吉之星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319033910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生又曰：天梁南斗，司夀之星，化氣為䕃為夀，佐上帝威權，為父母宫主，主人淸秀温和，形神𥡷重，性情磊落，善識兵法。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319050294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得昌曲左右加㑹，位至台省。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319066678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在父母宮，則厚重威嚴，㑹太陽於福徳，極品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319083062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戊巳生人合局，若四殺冲破，則苖而","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319099446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174813064953875"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不秀。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319099446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢天機耗曜，僧道清閑；如貪巨同度，則敗倫亂俗，在奴僕疾厄，亦非豐除之論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319115830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞刑忌見之，必無克敵之虞；火鈴刑暗，遇之，亦無征戰之撓。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319132214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太歲冲而為福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319148598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"白虎㑹","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319164982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"而無災。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書食，則有意外之荣；靑龍動則有文書之喜。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319164982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小耗大耗交遇，所幹無成。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319181366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"病符、官符相侵，不爲災。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319197750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319214134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人吉星入庙，旺夫益子，昌曲左右、扶持封贈，羊陀火忌冲破刑尅，招非不少。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319230518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319246902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天梁原属土，南斗最吉星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319263286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化䕃名延夀，父母宫主星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319279670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"田宅，兄弟内得之福自生。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319296054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形神自持重，心性更和平。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319312438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生來無災患，文","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319328822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174813065035795"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"章","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319328822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親更和睦，仕䆠居王庭。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319345206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門若相㑹，劳磅歴艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319361590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319377974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"逢天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機照，僧道享山林。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319377974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二星在辰戍，福夀不湏論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319394358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"問七殺星。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"668","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319410742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"669","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：七殺，南斗第六星也，属火金，乃斗中之上将，實成敗之孤辰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319427126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"670","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在斗司斗柄，主於風憲，其威作金之靈，其性若淸凉之状。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319443510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"671","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主於数，則冝僧道；主於身，定歷艱辛。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319459894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"672","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在命官若限，不扶夭折；在官祿得地，化以為祥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319476278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"673","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在子息而","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319492662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"674","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子息。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"675","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤卑，居夫婦而鴛衾半冷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319492662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"676","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㑹刑囚於田宅，父母刑傷父","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319509046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"677","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"母産業","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"678","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"難晋。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319509046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"679","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢刑忌殺于遷移，疾厄終身残疾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319525430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"680","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱使一身孤獨，也應夀年不長。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319541814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"681","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與囚於身命，折肢傷服，文主痨傷，會囚耗於遷移，死于道路。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319558198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"682","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若臨陷弱之宮，爲殘較减；若值正隂之宫，","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319574582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"683","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174813065183251"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"684","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"作禍𢙴深。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319574582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"685","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年殺曜莫教逢，身殺星辰休迭併。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319590966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"686","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身殺逢惡曜於要地，命逢殺曜于三方。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319607350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"687","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流殺又迭併，二限之中又逢，主陣亡掠死。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319623734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"688","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合太陽、巨門㑹帝旺之郷，則吉；處空亡，犯刑殺，遭禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319640118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"689","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小二限合身命，殺雖帝制也無功；三合對冲，雖禄亦無力。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319656502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"690","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖世英雄為殺制，此時一夣南柯。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319672886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"691","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此乃倒限之地，所主，務要仔細推詳，乃数中之𢙣曜，實非善星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319689270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"692","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：七殺斗中上将，遇紫㣲則化權降福；遇火鈴則爲殺長其威。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319705654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"693","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇㐫曜於生鄉，定為屠宰；㑹昌曲於要地，情性頑嚚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319722038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"694","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秘經云：七殺居䧟地，沉吟福不生。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319738422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"695","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319754806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"696","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二宮逢之，定歷艱辛；二限逢之，遭殃破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319771190","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"697","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇帝禄而可觧，遭流殺而逢㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319787574","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"698","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319803958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"699","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174867410583564"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"700","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命，作事進退，喜怒不常。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319803958","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"701","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右、昌曲入庙拱照，掌生殺之權，冨貴出衆。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319820342","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"702","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四殺忌星冲破，巧藝平常之人，䧟地殘疾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319836726","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"703","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命旺地，財權服衆，志過丈夫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319853110","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"704","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四殺冲破，刑尅不潔，僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319869494","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"705","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若殺凑飄蕩，流移還俗。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319885878","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"706","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：七殺寅、申、子、午宫，四夷拱手服英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319902262","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"707","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁鉞左右文昌㑹，權禄名高食萬鍾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319918646","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"708","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺居䧟地不堪言，㐫禍猶如抱虎眠。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319935030","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"709","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若是殺強無制伏，少年惡死到黄泉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319951414","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"710","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：破軍所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319967798","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"711","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：破軍属水，北斗弟七星也，司夫妻","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319984182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"712","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174867410714636"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"713","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子媳、奴僕之神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035319984182","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"714","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居子午入庙，在天為殺氣，在数為耗星，故化氣曰耗。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320000566","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"715","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主人暴凶狡詐，其性奸猾，與人寡合，動輟損人，不成人之惡善，助人之悪虐，視六親如冦仇，處骨肉無仁義。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320016950","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"716","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟六癸、六甲生人合格，主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320033334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"717","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陷地，加殺冲破，巧藝殘疾，不守祖業，僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320049718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"718","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人冲破，滛蕩無耻。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320066102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"719","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星居紫微則失威權，逢天府則作奸偽，㑹天機則𣆨𥨸狗偷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320082486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"720","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與𤎉貞、火鈴同度，則决起官方；與巨門同度，則口舌争聞；與刑忌同度，則終身殘疾；與武曲入財，則東傾西敗；與文星守命，一生貧士；遇諸㐫結党破敗，遇陥地，其禍不輕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320098870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"721","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟天梁可制其𢙣，天禄可觧其狂。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320115254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"722","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢流殺交併，家業蕩空，與文曲入於水域，殘疾離郷；遇文","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320131638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"723","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174914583887913"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"724","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昌入。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"725","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於震宫，遇吉可貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320131638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"726","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若女命逢之，無媒自嫁，喪莭飄流，瓦坐人身命居子午、貪狼七殺相拱，則威震華夷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320148022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"727","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或與武曲同居巳宫，貪狼拱亦。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320164406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"728","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居台閣，但㸔𢙣星何如。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320180790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"729","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚癸生人入格，到老亦不全美也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320197174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"730","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在身命䧟地，棄祖離宗，在兄弟骨肉参啇，在夫妻不正，主婚姻進退，在子息先損後成，在財帛如湯澆雪，在疾厄致。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320213558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"731","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尫羸之疾，在遷移奔走無力，在奴僕謗怨迯走，在官禄主淸貧在田。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320229942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"732","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"地䧟度，祖基破蕩，在福徳多災，在父母破相刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320246326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"733","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問文昌星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320262710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"734","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：文昌主科甲，守身命，主人𱐍閑儒雅，清秀魁梧，愽文廣記，機変異常，一舉成名，披緋衣紫，福","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320279094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"735","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174914584002601"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"736","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夀雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320279094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"737","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"縱四殺冲破，不為下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320295478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"738","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人加吉得地，衣禄充足；四殺冲破，偏房下僧道宜之，加權禄重厚，有師號。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320311862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"739","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：文昌主科甲，辰巳是旺地利午𭒡卯酉火，生人不利，眉目定。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320328246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"740","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分明相貌極，俊麗喜於金。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320344630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"741","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生人冨貴雙全美，先難而後易，中𣇋有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320361014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"742","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽䕃福集傳臚弟一名","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320377398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"743","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：文曲星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320393782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"744","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：文曲属水，北斗弟四星也，主科甲文章之宿。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320410166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"745","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其像属水，與文昌同協，吉数最為祥，臨身命中，作科弟之客。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320426550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"746","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"桃花浪煖，入仕無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320442934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"747","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"於官禄，靣君顔而執政，卑居身命，更逢㐫曜，亦作無名舌辨之徒。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320459318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"748","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與𤎉貞共處，必作公","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320492086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"749","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174914584117289"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"750","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吏官身；與太隂同行，定係九流術士。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320492086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"751","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕逢破軍，怨諨水以生災；𭒡遇貪狼，莊政事而𩔊倒。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320508470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"752","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢七殺刑忌囚，及諸𢙣曜，詐偽莫逃；逢巨門共其度邪而䘮志。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320524854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"753","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命不宜於逢水性楊花，忌入土宫，限臨蹭蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320541238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"754","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若禄存化禄來緾，不可以為㐫論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320557622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"755","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生曰：文曲守身，命居巳酉丑宫，居侯伯，武貪三合同垣，将相之格，文昌遇合亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320574006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"756","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陷宫午戍之地，巨門、羊陀冲破，喪命殀析，水大驚險。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320590390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"757","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居亥卯未旺地，與天梁、天相會，主聦明愽學，殺冲破，只冝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035320606774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"758","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若女命值之，清秀聦明，主貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331567658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"759","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陥地冲破，滛而且賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331584042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"760","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：流年昌曲若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331600426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"761","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：命逢流年昌曲，為科名科甲大小","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331616810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"762","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174961904074793"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"763","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限逢之，三合拱照太陽，又照流年禄小限太嵗逢魁鉞，左右台座，日月科權、禄馬三方拱照，决然高中無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331616810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"764","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然非此数星俱全，方為大吉，但以流年科甲為主。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331633194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"765","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命限值之，其餘吉曜，若得二三拱照，亦必高中。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331649578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"766","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"但二星在巳酉得地，不冨即貴，只是不能耐乆。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331665962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"767","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：南北昌曲星，数中推第一。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331682346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"768","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命最爲佳，諸吉恐非吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331698730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"769","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得居人命上，桃花浪三汲；入仕更無虚，從容要輔弼；只恐𢙣殺冲，火鈴、羊陀激。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331715114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"770","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若還逢陷地，苗而秀不實，不是公吏軰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331731498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"771","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"九流併數術。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331747882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"772","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無破，宰職權；女人，多滛佚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331764266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"773","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"樂居亥子丑，空亡宫無益。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331780650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"774","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174961904189481"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"775","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：左輔所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331797034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"776","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生答曰：左輔，帝極主宰之身命，諸宫降福，主人形貌敦厚，慷慨風流，紫府禄權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331813418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"777","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪武合冲照，主文武大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331829802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"778","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火忌冲破，雖冨貴不乆，僧道清閑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331846186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"779","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人温重賢曉，旺地封贈，火忌冲破，以中局断之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331862570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"780","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：右弼所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331878954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"781","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生答曰：右弼，帝極主宰之星，守身命，文墨精通，紫府吉星同垣，財官雙羙，文武雙全。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331895338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"782","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀火忌冲破，下局断之，女人賢良有志，縱四殺冲破，不為下賤，僧道清閑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331911722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"783","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：左輔原属𡈽，右弼水為根。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331928106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"784","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"失君為無用，三合冝見君。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331944490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"785","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在紫","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331960874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"786","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174961904304169"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"787","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㣲位，爵禄不湏論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331960874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"788","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若在夫妻位，主人定二婚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331977258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"789","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與𤎉貞併，惡賊遭鉗髠。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035331993642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"790","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼為上相，輔佐紫微星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332010026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"791","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喜居日月側，文人遇禹門。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332026410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"792","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"倘居閑位上，無爵更無名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332042794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"793","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妻宫遇此宿，决定两妻成。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332059178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"794","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與刑囚處，遭傷作盗論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332075562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"795","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天魁、天鉞星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332091946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"796","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：魁、鉞斗中司科之星，人命坐貴向貴，或得左右吉聚，無不富貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332108330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"797","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"况二星又為上界和合之神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332124714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"798","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若魁臨命，鉞守身，更迭相守，更遇紫府日月，昌曲，左右權禄相凑，少年必聚羙妻。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332141098","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"799","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若遇大難，必得貴人成就扶助。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332157482","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"800","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小人不一，亦不為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332173866","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"801","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限步廵逢，必主女子添喜。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332190250","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"802","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生男","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332206634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"803","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175012839751691"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"804","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"則俊雅入學，功名有成；生女則容貌端莊，出衆超群。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332206634","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"805","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若四十以後，逢墓庫，不依此断，有㐫不以為灾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332223018","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"806","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居官者賢能威武，声名逺播，僧道享福，與人和睦，不為下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332239402","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"807","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人吉，多宰輔之妻。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332255786","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"808","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命婦之論，若加悪殺，亦為富貴，但不免私情滛泆。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332272170","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"809","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天乙貴人衆所欽，命逢金帶福弥深。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332288554","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"810","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"飛騰名譽人争慕，慱雅皆通古與今。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332304938","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"811","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁鉞二星限中強，人人遇此廣錢粮。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332321322","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"812","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官吏逢之發財福，當年必定靣君王。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332337706","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"813","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：禄存星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332354090","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"814","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：禄存北斗弟三星，真","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332370474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"815","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175012839849995"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"816","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人之宿，主人貴爵，掌人夀基。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332370474","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"817","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝相扶之施權，日月得之増輝。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332386858","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"818","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天府武曲為厥職，天梁、天同共其詳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332403242","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"819","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十二宫惟身命田宅、財帛為𦂳，主冨居遷移則佳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332419626","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"820","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與帝星守官禄，冝子孫爵秩。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332436010","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"821","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨守命而無吉化，乃㸔財奴耳。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332452394","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"822","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢吉逞其權，遇𢙣敗其迹。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332468778","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"823","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"最嫌落於陥空，不能為福。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332485162","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"824","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更凑火鈴空刼，巧藝安身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332501546","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"825","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"盖禄爵當得勢而享之。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332517930","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"826","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守身命，主人慈厚信直，通文濟楚，女人清淑机巧，能幹能爲，有君子之志。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332534314","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"827","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府𤎉同會合，作祿存上局。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332550698","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"828","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵此星諸宮降福消灾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332567082","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"829","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然禄存陥居四墓之地者，盖以辰戊為魁罡，丑未為貴人之門，故祿辰遇之，良有以也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332583466","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"830","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332599850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"831","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175060478541878"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"832","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗禄存星，数中為上局。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332599850","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"833","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守值身命内，不貴多金玉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332616234","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"834","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此爲迪吉星，亦可登仕路。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332632618","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"835","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文人有聲名，武人有厚禄，常庶發橫財，僧道主獲福，官吏若逢之，断然食天禄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332649002","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"836","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又曰：夾禄拱貴，并化禄，命裡重逢金滿屋。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332665386","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"837","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不惟方丈比諸侯，一食萬鍾猶未足。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332681770","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"838","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存對靣守遷移，三合逢之利禄冝。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332698154","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"839","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得逢遐迩人欽敬，的然白手起家基。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332714538","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"840","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天馬星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332730922","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"841","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：諸宮各有制化，如身命臨之，謂之驛馬，喜禄存、紫府、昌曲守照為吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332747306","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"842","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如大小二限","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332763690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"843","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175060478640182"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"844","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨之，更遇禄存、紫府、流昌必利。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332763690","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"845","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如與禄存同宫，謂之禄馬交。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332780074","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"846","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馳又曰：折鞭馬，紫府同宫，謂之扶舉馬；刑殺同宫，謂之負尸馬；火星同宫，謂之戰馬；日月同宫，謂之雌雄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332796458","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"847","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬，逢空亡，謂之死亡；馬，居絶死，謂之死馬，遇陀羅，謂之折足馬。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332812842","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"848","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"以上犯此数者，俱主災病。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332829226","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"849","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"流年值之，依此断。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332845610","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"850","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：化禄星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332861994","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"851","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：禄為福徳之神，守身命官禄之位，科權相逢，必作大臣之職。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332878378","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"852","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限逢之，主進財入仕之喜，大限十年，吉慶無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332894762","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"853","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𢙣曜來臨，并羊陀火忌冲照，亦不為害。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332911146","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"854","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人吉凑作命婦。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332927530","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"855","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限逢之，内外威嚴，殺凑平常。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332943914","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"856","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：化權星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332960298","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"857","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：權星掌判生殺之神，","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332976682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"858","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175060478738486"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"859","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"守身命科禄相，出将入相，科權相逢，必定文章冠世，人皆欽仰。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332976682","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"860","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限相逢，無有不吉，大限十年，必然遂志。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035332993066","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"861","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢羊陀、耗使刼空，听說貽累，官災貶謫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333009450","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"862","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人得之，内外稱意，可作命婦僧道，掌山林，有師號。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333025834","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"863","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：化科星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333042218","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"864","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：科星上界應試，主掌文墨之星，守身命權禄相逢，宰臣之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333058602","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"865","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如逢𢙣曜，亦為文章秀士，可作群英師範。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333074986","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"866","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命吉供，主貴封贈，雖四殺冲破，亦爲冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333091370","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"867","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與科星拱冲同論。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333107754","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"868","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：化忌星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333124138","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"869","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：忌為多管之神，守身命，一生不順，小限逢之，二年不足，大限十年悔吝。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333140522","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"870","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限太歳","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333156906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"871","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175109665128502"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"交臨，斷然蹭蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333156906","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文人不耐乆，武人縱有官災，口舌不妨，雖啇賈枝藝人皆不冝利。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333173290","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如㑹紫府、昌曲，左右科權，禄與忌同宫，又兼四殺共處，即發，亦不住財，功名亦不成就。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035333189674","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如卑逢四殺，耗使刼空，主奔波𢃄疾，僧道流移還信，女人一生貧妖。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713249299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：擎羊星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713265683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：擎羊比斗之助星，守身命，性麄行暴，孤单則視親為踈，翻恩為怨，入庙性剛果决，机謀好勇，主權貴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713282067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北方生人為福，四墓生人不忌，居卯酉作禍興殃，刑尅極甚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713298451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"879","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六甲六戊生人，必有卤禍，縱冨貴不乆，亦不善終。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713314835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"880","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若九流工藝人，辛勤，加火忌刼空冲破，殘疾離祖，刑尅六親。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713331219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"881","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人入庙加吉，上局殺耗冲破，多主刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713347603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"882","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"下局。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713363987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"883","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175109665275958"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"884","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問陀羅星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713380371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"885","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：陀羅北斗之助星，守身命，心行不正，暗𰜜長流，性剛威猛，作事進退，横成橫破，飄蕩不定。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713396755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與貪狼同度，因酒色以成痨；與火鈴同處，定疥疫之不死。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713413139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居疾厄，暗疾緾綿。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713429523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"888","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戍丑未生人爲福，在庙財官論文人不耐","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713445907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"889","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"乆武。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"890","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人，横發高遷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713445907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"891","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若陥地加殺，刑尅招㐫，二姓延生，女人刑尅下賤。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713462291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"892","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"羊陀二星緫論","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"893","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉蟾先生曰：擎羊、陀羅二星，属火金，乃北斗浮星，在斗司奏，在數主㐫厄，羊化氣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713478675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"894","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰刑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713495059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"895","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陀化氣曰忌。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713511443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"896","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"怕臨兄弟田宅，父母","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713527827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"897","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三宫忌三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"898","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合臨，身命，合昌曲左右有暗痣，眼痣見日月，女尅","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713527827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"899","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175109665423414"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"900","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫而夫尅婦，為諸官之㐫神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713527827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"901","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌同日月，則傷親損目；刑併桃花，則風流惹禍。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713544211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"902","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌與貪狼合，因花酒以忘身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713560595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"903","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑與暗同行，招暗疾而壊目。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713576979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"904","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌與殺暗同度，招凌辱而生暗疾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713593363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"905","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"與火鈴為㐫伴，只冝僧道權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713609747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"906","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑合殺，疾病官厄，不免貪耗流年，面上刺痕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713626131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"907","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限更遇此，灾害不時而生也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713642515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：刑與暗同行，暗疾刑六親。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713658899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鈴遇凶俾，只冝道與僧權。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713675283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚合殺，疾病炎厄侵貪耗流年聚，面上刺痕新。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713691667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"911","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限運若逢此，横禍血刄生。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713708051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"912","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀夭夀殺人遇爲掃星。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713724435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"913","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子防恐惧，小人遭凌刑，遇耗决。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713740819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"914","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175173032787987"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"915","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乞求只冝林下人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713757203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"916","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限倘來犯，不時災禍侵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713773587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"917","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：火星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713789971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"918","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：火星乃南斗浮星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713806355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"919","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生歌曰：火星大殺将，南斗號殺神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713822739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"920","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若坐身命位，諸宫不可臨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713839123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"921","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性氣亦沉𣫭，剛強出衆人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713855507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"922","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"毛髪多異類，唇齒有傷痕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713871891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"923","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更與羊陀㑹，襁褓必災迍。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713888275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"924","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"過房出外飬，二姓可延生。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713904659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"925","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星東南利，不利西北生。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713921043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"926","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若得貪狼㑹，旺地貴無倫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713937427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"927","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"封侯居上将，勲業著邉庭。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713953811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"928","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方無殺破，中年後始興。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713970195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"929","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧首多飄蕩，不守規戒心。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035713986579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"930","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人旺地絜，陥地主邪滛。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714002963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"931","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑夫又尅子，下賤劳碌人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714019347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"932","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：鈴星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714035731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"933","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"荅曰：鈴星乃南斗助星也。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714052115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"934","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生歌曰：大殺鈴星将，南斗為從神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714068499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"935","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"值人身命者，性格","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714084883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"936","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175173032919059"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"937","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦沉吟。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714084883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"938","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"形貌多異類，威勢有聲名。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714101267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"939","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若與貪狼㑹，指日立邉庭。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714117651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"940","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庙地財官貴，陥地主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714134035","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"941","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀若凑合，其形大不清。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714150419","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"942","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤单并棄祖，殘傷帯疾人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714166803","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"943","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道多飄蕩，還俗定無倫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714183187","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"944","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女人無吉曜，刑尅少六親。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714199571","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"945","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"終身不貞絜，夀夭仍困貧。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714215955","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"946","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星大殺將，其𢙣不可禁。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714232339","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"947","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生有㐫福，聚實爲虚情。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714248723","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"948","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺主陣亡，破軍財屋傾。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714265107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"949","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉宿羊刑㑹，刼冝主刀兵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714281491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"950","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或遇貪狼宿，官禄亦不寕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714297875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"951","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢居旺地，冨貴不可倫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714314259","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"953","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"玉蟾先生曰：鈴火陀羅，金擎羊刑忌訣，一名馬掃星，又名短壽殺。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714330643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"954","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君子失其權，小人犯刑法。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714347027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"955","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"狐獨尅六親，災禍常不歇。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714363411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"956","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"腰","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714379795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"957","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175218624790567"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"958","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"足唇齒傷，劳碌多蹇剥。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714379795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"959","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破相又劳心，乞丐填溝壑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714396179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"960","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲併貪狼，一世招㐫𢙣。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714412563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"961","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"疾厄若逢之，四時不離着。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714428947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"962","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只冝山寺僧，金糓常安樂。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714445331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"963","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天空地刼所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714461715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"964","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：二星守身命，遇吉則吉，遇吉則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714478099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"965","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如四殺冲照，輕者下賤，重者六畜之命，僧道不正，女子婢妾，刑尅孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714494483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"966","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵二星俱不冝見，定主破財。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714510867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"967","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限逢之必㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714527251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"968","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：刼空為害最愁人，才智英雄誤一身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714543635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"969","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只好為僧併學術，堆金積玉也湏貧。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714560019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"970","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175218624888871"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"971","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天傷、天使星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714576403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"972","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：天傷乃上天虚耗之神，天使乃上天傳使之神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714592787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"973","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗二限逢之，不問得地否，只要吉多為福，其禍稍輕。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714609171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"974","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如無吉值巨門、羊陀火忌夭机，其年必主官災、䘮亡破敗。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714625555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"975","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：限至天耗號天傷，夫子在陳也絶粮。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714641939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"976","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天使限臨人共忌，石崇冨貴破家亡。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714658323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"977","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天刑星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714674707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"978","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：天刑守命，身不為僧道，定主孤刑，不貧則夭，父毋","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714691091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"979","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofcwti/1-1711802821794.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=MMjpNuH91TNbgD44GSremq0moys%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofcwti/1-1711802821794.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7587041035714691091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"980","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofd9gm/1-1711802827440.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=2W5ML7cIk%2BGLa%2BAjkCmB2hGqZMg%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofd9gm/1-1711802827440.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"7587041035714691091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"981","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不得全。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714691091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"982","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限逢之，主出家官事，牢獄失財。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714707475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"983","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"入庙則吉。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714723859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"984","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175218625019943"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"985","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714740243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"986","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天刑。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"987","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"未必是㐫星入庙，名為天喜神。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714740243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"988","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲吉星來凑合，定然献策到王庭。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714756627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"989","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑居","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714773011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"990","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅上并酉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"991","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"戍，更臨卯位自光明，必遇文星成大業，掌握邉彊百萬兵。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714773011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"992","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三不了兮號天刑，為僧為道是孤身。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714789395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"993","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天哭二星皆同到，終是難逃有疾人。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714805779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"994","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"問：天姚星所主若何？","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714822163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"995","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：天姚守身命，心性隂毒，多疑惑，善顔色風流，多婢主滛，入庙旺，主冨貴，多奴。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714838547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"996","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居亥，有學識，㑹惡星，破家敗産，因色犯刑。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714854931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"997","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六合重逢，少年夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035714871315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"998","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725832235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"999","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175270499942441"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1000","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨限不用媒妁，招手成婚，或紫微吉星加剛柔相濟，主風騷，加紅鵉愈淫，加刑刄主夭。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725832235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1001","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歌曰：天姚居戌卯酉逰，更入雙魚一併求。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725848619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1002","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"福厚生成躭酒色，無災無禍度春秋。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725865003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1003","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天姚星與敗星同，號曰人間掃氣囂。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725881387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1004","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛若平生過一世，不曽安亦在家中。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725897771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1005","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人身偶尔值天姚，恋色貪花性箒㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725914155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1006","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此曜若居生旺地，位登極品亦風騷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725930539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1008","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"希夷先生荅曰：哭虚為悪曜，","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725963307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1009","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175270500040745"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1010","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"臨命最非常。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725963307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1011","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加臨父母内，破蕩賣田庄。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725979691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1012","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若教身命陷，竆獨帶刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035725996075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1013","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六親多不足，煩惱過時光。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035726012459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1014","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"東謀西不就，心事揔忙。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035726028843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1015","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七丑","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1016","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯申宫吉，遇禄名題揚。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035726045227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1017","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限若逢之，哀七哭断腸。","logicSentenceId":"7587041035726061611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1018","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175270500155433"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175311667036172"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"2","lineNum":0,"lineType":4,"content":"新鋟希夷陳先生紫㣲斗数全書卷之二","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374272050","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太極星緾，乃群宿衆星之主，天門運限，即扶身助命之原。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374304818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在天則運用無常，在人則命有格局。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374321202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先明格局，次看𢙣星。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374337586","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或有同年同月、同日同時而生，則有貧賤富貴夀殀之異。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374353970","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或在惡限，積百萬之金銀；或在旺郷，𮞸連年之困苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374370354","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禍福不一途而推，吉㐫不可一例而断。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374386738","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"要知一世之荣枯，定看五行之宫位。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374403122","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"立命便知貴賤，安身即曉根基。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374419506","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一先看福徳，再三細考遷移。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374435890","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"分對宫之体用，定三合之源流。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374452274","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命無正曜，殀折孤貧；士有㐫星，羙玉瑕玷。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374468658","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"既得根基堅固，湏知合局相生。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374485042","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"堅固則冨貴","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374501426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174618495598632"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"延壽，相生則財官昭著。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374501426","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命好身好限好，到老荣昌；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374517810","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐長生帝旺之郷，本宫又得士星庙旺，及大小二限，又遇相生吉地吉星，則一世謀為，無不順遂。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命衰身衰限衰，終身乞丐。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374534194","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命居死絶之郷，本宫不見吉化，更會羊陀、火鈴、空刼諸般𢙣曜，而運限又無吉星接應，定主貧賤。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾貴夾禄少人知，夾權夾科世所冝，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374550578","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如丙丁壬癸生人在辰戍安命，魁鉞加夾，更遇紫微天府、日月權禄，左右昌曲，夾身夾命，是左夾貴，冨貴必矣。如甲生人，身命丑卯，而寅禄居中，是生成之禄，尢為上格。其餘者，若甲寅、乙卯、庚申、立酉，四位俱同此格。如甲生人，安命在子，𤎉貞化禄居亥，破軍化權居丑，是科權禄夾命，定主冨貴，餘皆做此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾月夾日誰能遇。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374566962","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾昌夾曲七貴兮，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374583346","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175311667216396"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如太陽、太隂在身命前後二宫夾命，不逢空刼羊鈴，其貴必矣。如昌曲夾命亦如之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾空、夾刼主貧賤；夾羊、夾陀為乞丐，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374599730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命化忌遇天空、地刼、羊陀等殺夾身命者，及𤎉、破、武等星值之，定主孤寒下格，如不應即夭。又如命化忌𤎉貞、羊陀、火鈴來夾者，亦為下格。或禄在生旺酉地，雖夾禄羊陀，不為下格。又或羊陀空刼不並臨，及三方遇權禄者，亦","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不在夾敗論，但逢殺運有災。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374599730","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉贞七殺，反為積冨之人；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374616114","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"𤎉貞属火，七殺属金，是火能制金為權。如貞居未，殺居午，身命遇之，竒格也，反為積冨，或陷也，化忌下格，賎命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天梁、太隂却作飄蓬之客，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374632498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大隂居卯辰巳午，俱為陥地，如亥巳二宫遇天梁，坐於身命，定主孤寒，不然飄蕩他郷，躭恋酒色徒耳。又云：梁雖不","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陥亦不作敦厚之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374632498","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞主下賤之孤寒，太隂主一生之快樂，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374648882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174618495664168"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命巳亥遇𤎉貞，乃為䧟地三方，前後二宫，又無吉星拱夾，名為貧賎。又如身命自未至子宫，遇太隂，必主宣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴或吉多，冨貴不小，或吉少，亦主刀筆功名。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374648882","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先貧後冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374665266","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武貪同身命之宫，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374681650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命立丑未二星同宮，盖武曲之金尅貪狼之木，則木逢制化為有用，故先雖貧而後方冨貴也。又或得三方有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲左右等星拱照，主貴限逢科，權禄則貴顯至矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374681650","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先冨後貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374698034","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"只為運逢刼殺，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374714418","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如身命宮或有一二正曜出門，亦遇吉限，至中年，限行絶地，兼遇刼空、耗殺等㐫，則身命無力，故後貧也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"出世荣華，權禄守財福之位，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374730802","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"權禄守財帛，福德入庙吉多，定主荣華，身命值之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生來貧賤，刼空臨財福之郷。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374747186","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刼空在財帛、福徳二宫，多主人貧贱。如身命值之亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175369208676363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文昌、文曲。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"為人多學多能，左輔右弼，秉性克守克厚，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374763570","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如辰戌、巳亥、卯酉安命，遇昌曲二星是也。有昌曲坐命未宫，見羊陀等殺者，灾殀。故所看法全要活変。如左右二星坐命，不拘星辰多少，亦主寛厚","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天府、天相。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"乃為衣禄之神；為仕為官，定主亨通之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374779954","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如丑安命巳酉府相來朝，未安命亥卯府相來。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝是也，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374796338","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"甲生人無殺，依此断，如加殺不是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"苗而不秀，科名陥於㐫神，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374812722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如科星䧟於空刼羊陀之中，在卯雖又為，或化吉科太權。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽在戌，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374812722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄亦。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化科太不隂。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374812722","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"為美也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"發不主財祿，主緾于弱地。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374829106","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如化禄陥于刼空是也。又或子午申酉宫，雖化禄無用，亦主孤貧。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺朝斗，爵禄荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374845490","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"70","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如寅、申、子、午四宮安身命，七殺值之是也。亦要左右、魁","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174987019501620"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"鉞、昌曲坐照拱合，一生富貴荣華，或遇吉限尤美。若加殺不是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府同宫，終身福厚。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374861874","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅、申二宫安命，值紫微、天府同宫，三方有左右魁鉞拱照，必主富貴，終身福厚。甲生人化吉拯美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微居午，無殺湊，位至公卿；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374878258","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"76","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲丁巳生人，安命午宫值之，入格生大貴，其餘官亦主冨足，或小貴，若加殺不是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"77","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天府臨戌，有星扶，腰金衣紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374894642","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"78","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲巳生人，安命戍宫值之，依此断，加殺不是。要有魁鉞左右禄權科，主大冨貴。如無此吉星，亦平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
