{"lines":[{"lineId":"79","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科權祿拱，名譽昭彰；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374911026","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"80","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此為三化士星。如身命坐守，一化財帛、官禄宫，二化來合，是三合守照，謂之科權禄拱是也。加左右，位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"81","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲庙垣，威名赫奕。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374927410","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"82","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175369208823819"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"83","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如辰、戌二宫安命值之上格，丑未安命次之，冝見權、祿、左右、昌、曲諸吉星，則依此断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"84","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科明禄暗，位列三台。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374943794","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"85","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生人安命亥宫，值科星守在命官，又天禄居寅，則寅與亥合，故日科明禄暗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"86","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月同","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374960178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"87","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"臨官","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居侯伯。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374960178","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命安丑宫，日月在未，命安未宫，日月在丑，謂之同臨是也。訣云：日月同臨論對宫，丙辛人遇福興隆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨機同宫，公卿之位；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374976562","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如辛、乙生人，安命卯宫，二星守命，更遇昌左右上格，如丙生人次之，丁生人亦主平常，其餘宫分，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪鈴並守，将相之名。","logicSentenceId":"7580361736374992946","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如辰戌丑未子宫安命值之，是為入庙，依此断。如加吉，惟子辰二宫坐守尤佳。戊巳生人合格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天魁天鉞，盖世文章；","logicSentenceId":"7580361736375009330","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174987019567156"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如身命坐魁，對宫天鉞，身命坐鉞，對宫天魁，是謂坐貴向貴，更會吉化，其貴必然矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天禄天馬，驚人甲第，","logicSentenceId":"7580361736375025714","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅、申巳亥四宫安命，值天禄、天馬坐守命宫，更三合吉守照，依此断加殺不是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左輔文昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713367049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"會吉星，尊居八位；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713383433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如此二星坐守身命，更三方吉拱，依此断，加殺刼空，不合此格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼火星，居庙旺，名鎮諸邦。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713399817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辰戌、丑未四宮安命，值此上格，三方吉化拱照尢美。如卯宫安命，無殺次之，加羊陀、刼空不是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨日同宫，官封三代；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713416201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅宫安命，值此無刼空四殺，上格申宫，次之，巳亥不為美。如已宫有日守命垣，亥有巨者，上格已有巨守命，亥有日者，不美；下格申有日守日，來同垣無殺，加平常之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175439601664036"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府朝垣，食禄萬鍾，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713432585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅宮安命午戍宫，紫府來朝；申宫安命子、辰二宫，有紫府來朝，是為人君訪臣之象，竒格也。更遇流禄巡逢，必然位至公卿。如七殺在寅申坐命者，亦為上格，加四殺加化忌，為平常人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科權對拱，躍三汲於禹門，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713448969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"科權二星在遷移，財帛、官禄。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方對拱是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713448969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"或命宫有化，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713465353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"科權禄三方守照，無殺亦然","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日月並","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明，佐九重於堯殿，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713481737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如安命丑宫，日在巳，月在酉，來朝照，為並明辛乙生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人合","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713481737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"格如丙生人主貴，丁生人主富，加四殺空刼，忌平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府相同，來㑹命宫，全家食禄","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713498121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三合照臨，更遇本宫吉多，身命無敗，是為府相朝垣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之格。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713498121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"富貴必矣。訣云：府相朝垣格最良，出仕為官大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合明珠生旺地，𥡷歩蟾宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713514505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174987019632692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如在未宫安命，日在卯宫，月在亥宫來朝照，為明珠出海，定主財官雙美。如辰官日守命，戍宫月對照，戍宫月守命。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰宫日對照，必主極貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713530889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺破軍，冝出外","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713547273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星會身、命於䧟地，主諸般手藝能精，出外可也，殺寅、申，軍已、亥論之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機月同梁，作吏人","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713563657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"比四星必身命三合曲全，方准刀筆，功名可就。加殺化忌下。格訣云：寅申㑹同梁机月，必定作吏人，若無四三考成星難。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府日月居旺地，断定公侯噐","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713580041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紫午宫府戍宫，日卯辰宫，月酉戍亥，又化禄科權坐身命守是也。加殺刼空忌，不是，此格美玉瑕玷","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"日","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月科祿丑宫中，定是方伯公","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713596425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丑未安命，日月化，科禄坐守是也。如無吉化，雖曰月同宫，不為羙也。訣云：日月丑未命中逢，三方無吉福無生若還。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175439601811492"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化方為羙，方面威權福禄増。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713596425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天梁天馬陷，飄蕩無疑。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713612809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥申宫安命，值天梁失䧟，而天馬同宫，又或陥於火羅空刼，依此而断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞殺不加，聲名逺播。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713629193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"143","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"殺，謂四殺也。如卯宫安命，值之，主貴，亦冝三合吉照是也。加殺平常，或在未、申二宫，坐命無殺亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日照雷門，荣華富貴；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713645577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯宫安命，太陽坐守，更三方左右，昌曲、魁、鉞守照，冨貴不小。甲乙、庚、辛生人合格，加刑，忌四殺，亦主温飽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月朗天門，進爵封侯，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713661961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"亥宫安命，太隂坐守，更三方吉拱，主大冨貴，無吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦主","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713661961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"雜聀功名，丙丁生人主貴，壬癸生人主冨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅逢府相，位登一品之荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713678345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅宫安命府。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午宮相，戍宮來朝，甲生人遇之是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713694729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如加殺","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713711113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174987019698228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不是。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713711113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如酉宫安命，丑府巳相來朝，亦貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713727497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"墓逢左右，尊居八座之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713743881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、戍丑未安命二星坐守是也。或遷移、官禄、財帛三宫遇之，亦主福壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"梁居午位，官資淸顕；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713760265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午宫安命，天梁坐守，是也。丁生人上格，巳生人次之，癸生人主冨，又次之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曲遇梁星，位至台綱。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713776649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午宫安命，二星同宫坐守，上格，寅宫次之，或梁在","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"午曲在","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713793033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子拱冲者，亦官至二三品貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科禄廵逢，周勃欣然入相；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713809417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫有吉，坐守三方，化吉拱冲，或命前三位，遇科權禄，皆主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文星暗拱，賈誼允矣登科。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713825801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命宫有吉，遷移官禄財帛，三","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713842185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175439601926180"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"方","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有昌曲，科星朝拱者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713842185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊火星，威權出衆，同行貪武，威壓邉夷，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713858569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戌丑未四墓安命，遇羊、火二星入庙，文武双全，兵權萬里。如貪狼、武曲遇火旺地，亦同此格断","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"李廣不封擎羊逢於力士，二星守命縱吉，多平常之論。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713874953","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加殺最㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713891337","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"女命不論。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713907721","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"顔回夭折，文昌䧟於天殤。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713924105","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如丑生人安命寅宫，其文昌䧟于未宫，天殤流年，又遇七殺及羊陀迭併之限，依此断凖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"仲由猛烈，𤎉貞入庙，遇将軍，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713940489","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"立命申宫，此二星坐守是也，餘倣此。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子羽材能，巨宿同梁冲且合，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713956873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"羽命立申宫，子宫有天同，寅宫有巨門，辰有天梁，又得科權、禄，左右拱冲合，此格是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330174987019763764"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅申最喜同梁㑹","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713973257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"寅宫安命，值同梁化吉，甲庚及中生人冨貴。又如申宫安命，值同梁化吉，甲庚及寅生人冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辰戌應嫌陥巨門。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013713989641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、戍二宫安命，值巨門失陥，主人作事顛倒，加殺，主唇舌之非，刑傷不免，更遇𢙣限尢㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄倒馬倒忌太嵗之合刧空，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714006025","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如禄馬臨敗絶空亡之地，而太嵗流年復㑹地刼天空，主駁雜災悔，發不住財之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運衰限衰，喜紫微之解㐫𢙣。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714022409","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如大小二限不逢吉曜，而身命有紫微守照，則限雖㐫，亦主平𥡷，盖以身命有主故也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"孤貧多有夀，富貴即殀亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714038793","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"193","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命主星弱，及財官子息陷地，亦冝减禄延壽是也。灭如太嵗坐命，主星又弱，或財官迁移化吉，或又行吉限定注","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"194","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175492873584651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"撗發不乆及十年，二十年運過即殀亡也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714055177","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吊客䘮門，緑珠有墜搂之厄；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714071561","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"197","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大小二限遇前有䘮門，後有吊客，及太嵗逢㐫星，必𮞸驚險是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫符太歳，公冶有縹絏之憂。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714087945","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命官二星坐守，及二限，又遇官符等殺，依此断。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714104329","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"限至天羅地網，屈原曽溺水而亡；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714120713","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二限行至辰、戌二宫，逢武曲、貪狼，更有太嵗、喪吊、白虎及刼空四殺，或一逢冲照，其限最㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"運遇地刼天空，阮籍有貧窮之苦。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714137097","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"203","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"二限十二宫中，但遇刼空二星，雖吉多，亦財來財去。如見流年殺曜㐫星，定主貧困。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"204","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌文曲㑹𤎉貞，䘮命殀年，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714153481","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"205","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥二宫，安命值之是也。辛生人最忌。若武曲、天相、財印之星隨之，反為得貴主権。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"206","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175431884210211"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"207","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命空限空，無吉凑功名蹭蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714169865","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"208","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命限逢空加殺，其功名必不能就。或有正星吉化，逢空刼命限，亦主灯火辛勤，不得上達。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"209","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢逢空，猶如半天折翹；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714186249","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"210","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫值天空坐守，作平常之論，尤恐中年跌剥。倘横發，必主㐫亡。如命在亥，子時生人；命在巳，午時生人，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"211","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命中遇刼，恰如浪裡行船。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714202633","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"212","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫遇地刼坐守，作平常論，亦不住財。若加殺，忌尤甚㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"213","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項羽英雄，限至天空而喪國。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714219017","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"214","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小二限俱逢天空是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714235401","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"215","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"石崇豪冨，限行刼地以亡家。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714251785","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"216","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大小二限臨于夾陷之地，更遇流陀等殺必㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714268169","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"217","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吕后專權，两重天禄、天馬，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714284553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"218","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175492873715723"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"219","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄存又逢。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"220","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化禄及天馬同守命宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714284553","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"221","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"楊妃好色，三合文曲，文昌、","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714300937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"222","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命宫及財官迁移。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"223","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲合照，更㑹太隂、天机，必主滛泆也。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714300937","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"224","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天梁遇馬，女命賎而且滛；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714317321","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"225","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如寅、申巳亥四宫安命，遇天馬坐守，而三方遥、天梁合照，是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"226","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昌曲","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"227","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夾墀男命，貴而且顕。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714333705","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"228","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽為母墀，太隂為桂墀，如太陽、太隂在丑未安命，而前後二言，有左右、昌曲、來夾是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"229","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"極居卯酉，多為脫俗僧人；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714350089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"230","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"紫微爲北拯，如坐守命宫，加殺，定主僧道，無殺加吉。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"231","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化左；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714350089","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"232","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"右魁鉄，常人可貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"233","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貞居卯酉，定是公胥吏軰。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714366473","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"234","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"卯酉安命𤎉貞坐守加殺，必作公門胥吏僕役。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"235","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175431884308515"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"236","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左府同宫，尊居萬乘；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714382857","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"237","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、戌二宫安命，值此二星坐守，更會三方吉化拱冲，必居極品之貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"238","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞七殺，流蕩天涯。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714399241","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"239","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥二官安命，值此二星，更加殺、化忌、逢空刼，流蕩天涯，不得守家。軍商在外，艱辛是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"240","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鄧通餓死，運逢大耗之郷；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714415625","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"241","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"通命安在子宫二限，行至夾限之地，大耗逢之，更㑹惡曜是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"242","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"夫子絶粮，限到天殤之内。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714432009","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"243","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"與上同断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"244","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"鈴昌羅武，限至投河；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714448393","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"245","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此四星交會辰、戍二宫，辛壬巳生人二限行至辰戍，最悪水厄，又加悪殺，必死外道。如四星在辰戍坐命亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"246","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175492873814027"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"247","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨火擎羊，終身縊死。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714464777","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"248","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此三星坐守身命，大小二限，又逢悪殺不羙，依此断。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714481161","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"249","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命裡逢空，不飄流即主疾若。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714497545","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"250","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命宫不見正星，单值天空坐守，更三合加殺、化忌，依此断；加吉星，亦不至此甚也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"251","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭𢃄劔，非殀折，則主刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714513929","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"252","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"擎羊在午守命，卯次之，酉又次之，為羊刄落䧟是也。寅、申巳、亥四宫陀羅守命亦然，如辰、戍丑未不忌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"253","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午破軍，加官進禄。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714530313","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"254","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午二宫逢破軍守命加吉星，必然位至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714546697","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"255","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌貪居命，粉骨碎屍；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714563081","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"256","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如已、亥二宫安命，值此二星坐守，加殺化，忌夭亡，或官禄官遇之，亦是。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"257","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"朝斗仰斗，爵禄荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714579465","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"258","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175431884390435"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"259","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七殺守命旺宫是也。如子、午、寅、申為朝斗，三方為仰斗，入格者冨貴。若迂移官禄二宫，不在此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"260","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文桂文華，九重貴顕。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714595849","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"261","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文昌為文桂，文曲為文華。如丑未安命值之，更化吉及三合吉星拱夾是也。或無吉化，雖昌曲，無用且妖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"262","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丹墀桂墀，早遂靑雲之志；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714612233","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"263","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"丹墀謂日居卯、辰、已，桂墀謂月入酉、戍、亥，此六宫身命值之是也，亦冝見昌曲、魁、鉞。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"264","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"合禄拱禄，定爲巨擘之臣。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714628617","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"265","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄存與化禄在財官二宫合命，或命坐禄而迁移，有禄對拱，皆主冨貴。秘云：合禄拱禄堆金王，爵位高迁衣紫袍。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"266","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂陽㑹昌曲，出世荣華；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714645001","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"267","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐隂陽財官二宫，昌曲來會，或命坐昌曲，財官日月來㑹，更遇魁鉞吉星，冨貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"268","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼遇財官，衣緋着紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714661385","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"269","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175574880649228"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"270","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命身有正星化吉，遇三方財帛、官禄宫，有輔弼來朝是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"271","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨梁相會𤎉貪并，合禄鴛鴦一世荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714677769","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"272","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巨梁、貪、亷四星，身命三合相逢，庙地並吉。又如祿存化禄，居夫妻宫，有禄來合，亦主富貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"273","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲閑宫多手藝，貪狼䧟地作屠人。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714694153","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"274","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"武曲巳亥宫守命加殺者，手藝安身。貪狼巳亥守命加殺者，必作屠牛宰馬之人。或貪貞巳亥加殺化忌者，殀夀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"275","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天禄朝垣身土貴題。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714710537","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"276","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲生人立命寅宫，甲禄到寅守命，亦作禄朝垣格。又如庚禄在申，乙禄在卯，辛禄在酉，此四位禄存守命宫，俱依比断在已亥、子午四宫，不為禄朝垣格也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"277","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁星臨命，位列三台。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714726921","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"278","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如午宫安命，紫微守坐，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714743305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"279","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇文昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"280","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁鉞同宫，一生人竒格。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714743305","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"281","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲居乾戌亥上，最怕太隂逢貪狼。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714759689","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"282","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175579729182755"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"283","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"武曲在戌亥守命，三方見太隂、貧狼、化忌、加殺不為美也，定主少年不利。或有貪火冲破，主貴者，甲、己、壬生人合格。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"284","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化禄還爲好，休向墓中藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714776073","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"285","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如武曲、太隂、貪狼化禄，守照命宫，更加吉曜，亦冨貴。但辰、戌、丑未四宫，雖化吉，無用。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"286","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"子午巨門，石中隱玉；","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714792457","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"287","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子午二宫安身，命值巨門坐午，更得寅戌申辰，科禄合照，冨貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"288","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明禄暗禄，錦上添花。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714808841","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"289","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如甲生人立命亥宫，得化禄坐守，又得寅禄來貪，盖寅與亥合之謂也。與前科明祿暗禄格同断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"290","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲辰戌遇破軍，冨而不貴肴虚名。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714825225","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"291","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰、戍二宫安命，遇紫微破軍，實為䧟地，必不贵也。綫使發財，亦無寳受。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"292","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲破軍逢刑尅，多劳碌。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714841609","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"293","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175574880763916"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"294","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如卯酉辰戍，破軍守命，雖得文昌、文曲，亦非全吉。若加殺化忌，更不足貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"295","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪武墓中居，三十𦂯發福。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714857993","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"296","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辰、戍、丑、未四墓宫，得二星守命，定主少年不利，加殺忌殀。訣云：貪武不發少午人，運過三十方延壽。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"297","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天同戍宫為反背，丁人化吉主大貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714874377","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"298","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"盖天同在戍宫，本䧟，如遇丁生人，則午宫祿存化禄，更得寅辰化吉冲照拱，定主大貴。天相亦然，加殺僧道下局。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"299","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門辰戍為陥地，辛人化吉禄峥嵘。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714890761","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"300","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"辰戍巨門坐命，本為蹈地，如辛生人，則巨門化禄，在辰則酉禄暗合，在戍則酉禄夾命，必主冨貴，加殺非也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"301","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"機梁酉上化吉者，縱遇財官也不荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714907145","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"302","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"酉宫安机、梁二星，寔為陥地，雖逢化吉，無力，巨門同亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"303","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"曰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"304","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"月最嫌反背，乃為失輝。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714923529","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"305","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175579729297443"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"306","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽在申酉戍亥子，太隂在寅卯辰巳午，則日月無輝，向貴之有。然有日月反背而多冨貴者，要看本宫三合，有吉化拱照不加殺是也。故王蟾先生甞曰：数中議論最精㣲，断法在人活變竒。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"307","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命定要精求，恐差分数，","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714939913","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"308","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"哉安身命，先辨時辰真，則命無不應。身命既定之後，即看本宮生旺死絶何如，然後依星推断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"309","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂隲延年増百福。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714956297","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"310","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"至於陥地不𮞸傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714972681","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"311","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身命星弱，及行弱限，反得福壽，此必心好隂隲所致。余嘗驗之。舎親李逢春，隨兄任湖廣，遇一相師，相他壽促，可速歸之。及至，中途風阻，見一貧者，周之錢米，其人感德，将親女陪奉。逢春固辭而囬，後無一恙。復之兄任，其相師見之，笑曰：先生隂隲相现矣，後當居台閣。再三問之，春不對。及後徐探，方知其故。今果逰泮，此其騐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"312","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命實運堅，稿苗得雨；命衰限弱，嫩草𮞸霜。","logicSentenceId":"7580362013714989065","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"313","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐陥地，却有四靣吉拱，亦爲福論。又如命生陥地，運逢𢙣殺，必主災悔。若夫命實運堅，其福不必言矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"314","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175648534200332"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"315","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論命必推星善𢙣。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935711790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"316","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨破擎羊，性必剛","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935728174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"317","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此三星守命，若居䧟地，不但性剛巳也，定主唇。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"318","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"舌是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935728174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"319","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935744558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"320","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"殺傷残破敗。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"321","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府相同梁性必好，火刼空貪性不常。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935760942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"322","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"府相同梁，皆南斗純陽中正之星，身命值之，必得中和之性。若貪狼遇火，固當冨貴，但空刼臨之，則依此断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"323","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"昌曲禄機清秀巧，隂陽左右最慈祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935777326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"324","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"昌曲禄机守。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"325","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不加四殺，主人磊落英華，聦明秀鹿，亦當","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935793710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"326","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冨貴如隂陽，左右守命，不加殺主。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"327","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人清竒敦厚，度量寛洪","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935793710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"328","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"冨貴","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"329","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之論。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935793710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"330","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武破貞、貪冲合曲全固貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935810094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"331","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀七殺相雜，互見則傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935826478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"332","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身命三合遇武破、㢘貪守照，更得化吉，冨貴必矣。要知紫微能降七殺威權，能使羊陀相善，故紫微同居命宫固佳，在冲合亦可。但七殺羊鈴，終非吉兆之曜，到老亦不得善終也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"333","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175579729379363"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"334","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼、𤎉貞破軍惡七殺擎羊陀羅文","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935842862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"335","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"身命二合，有六星守照，更兼化忌，不見吉，定主滛邪、破敗、殘傷、刑尅。如入庙化吉，亦與前同看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"336","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火星、鈴星專作禍，刼空、傷使禍重重。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935859246","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"337","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大小二限值此㐫星，定主災悔多端。如身命逢之加吉，火鈴無害，刼空不冝。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"338","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門忌星皆不吉，運身命限忌相逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935875630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"339","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫忌星乃多管之神，十二宫身命二限逢之，皆主不吉。况巨門本非吉曜，若䧟地化此，何吉之有一。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"340","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更兼太嵗官符至，官非口舌决不空。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935892014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"341","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫太嵗官符，本為興訟之神，况巨門乃是非之曜，又兼化忌臨之，其官符口舌必不能免。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"342","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吊客喪門又相遇，管敎災病两相攻。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935908398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"343","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"夫吊客、喪門，本主刑孝，但不逢七殺刑刄，猶或可免，若災病則必有也。况忌星最能生疾。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"344","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175648534331404"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"345","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺守身終是夭，貪狼入庙必為娼。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935924782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"346","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"七殺守身命，䧟地加㐫依此断。如貪狼守命，雖不加殺，或在曰合照臨，亦王滛法。如加殺䧟地，則男主飄蕩，女主滛乱。秘云：貪狼三合相臨照，也學韓君去𥨸香。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"347","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"心好命微亦主夀，心毒命固亦殀七。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935941166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"348","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"上句即前隂騭論之説，下句與上句反看，便見。譬如諸葛孔明用智燒藤甲軍，乃减数年之夀是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"349","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"今人命有千金貴，運去之時豈乆長。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935957550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"350","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"数内包藏多少理，學者湏當仔細詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935973934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"351","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"女命骨髓賦註觧","logicSentenceId":"7580371550935990318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"352","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"府相之星女命緾，必當子貴與夫賢，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936006702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"353","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"午宮安命二星坐守，甲生人合格；子宫安命二星坐守，巳生人合格；申宮安命二星坐守，庚生人合格，必作命婦荣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"354","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175579729477667"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"355","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"膺封誥是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936006702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"356","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞清白能相守，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936023086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"357","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此星未宮坐命，甲生人合格；申宫坐命，癸生人合格；寅宫坐命，巳生人合格，俱為上格看。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"358","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更有天同理亦然。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936039470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"359","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此星寅宫坐命，甲生人合格；卯宮坐命，甲生人合格；戌宫坐命，丁生人合格；巳宫坐命，丙、辛生人合格；亥宮坐命，丙、午生人合格，俱主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"360","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"端正紫微太陽星，早遇賢夫性可慿。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936055854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"361","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子巳亥三宫安命二星坐守，主冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"362","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽寅到午，遇吉終是福。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936072238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"363","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太陽午宫安命，定主冨貴，䧟地平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"364","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左輔天魁為福夀，右弼天相福相臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936088622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"365","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175648534446092"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"366","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"四星諸宫得地，如身命值此坐守，定主福夀荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"367","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存厚重多衣食，府相朝垣命必荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936105006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"368","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"禄存諸宫守命並吉，紫府武相三合守照，不貴即冨。惟寅在申，申在寅，為朝垣之格，甲庚生人上局，辛生人次之。如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"369","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙戊丁巳壬癸生人，遇巳亥子午安命，不吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936121390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"370","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府已亥相互輔，左右扶持福必生。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936137774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"371","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥二宫安命，遇紫府左右守照冲夾，更兼化吉星，主冨貴必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"372","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門天機爲破蕩。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936154158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"373","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯申宫安命，巨机逢之，雖為旺地，然終福不全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936170542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"374","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天梁月曜女命貧。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936186926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"375","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳亥安命，天梁值之；寅辰安命，太隂值之，縱使貞正，衣禄不遂。如陷地，主下贱。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"376","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊火星為下賤，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936203310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"377","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175678974869519"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"378","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星守命旺宫猶可，但刑尅不免耳。如居䧟地，加殺，主下賤，不然，則天","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"379","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文昌文曲福不全。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936219694","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"380","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此二星冝男不冝女。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"381","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲之宿爲寡宿，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936236078","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"382","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此星冝男不冝女，如值太隂得令，三方吉拱，可為女将。如陷地遇昌曲加殺，主孤寡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"383","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍一曜性難明。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936252462","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"384","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此孤獨滛泆之星，女人不冝加四殺，必因奸謀夫，因妬害子，不然，則為下婢娼如可也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"385","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼内狼多滛泆，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936268846","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"386","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此名為𣑯花，乃好色之星，不容妾婢，心有嫉妬，因奸謀夫害子，縦不至此之甚，其滛泆最騐。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"387","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺沉吟福不荣，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936285230","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"388","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388647948"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"389","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此将相之星，若居庙旺，主為女将。訣云：机月寅申女命逢，惡殺加之滛巧容。便有吉化終不羙，偏房侍奉主人翁。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"390","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十干化禄最荣昌，女命逢之大吉昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936301614","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"391","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更得禄存相凑合，旺夫益子受恩光。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936317998","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"392","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如命坐化禄，又得禄存冲合，或巡逢，或同宫，皆","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"393","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"主命婦之。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936334382","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"394","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"貴，不然亦主大冨，必生貴子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"395","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火鈴羊陀及巨門，天空地刼又相臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936350766","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"396","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼七殺𤎉貞宿，武曲加臨尅害侵。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936367150","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"397","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"大抵此数星，女命不冝逢，如内逢一二，亦主滛賤。若併見之，其下賤貧殀必矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"398","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"399","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"方四正嫌逢殺，更在夫宫禍患深。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936383534","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"400","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若值本宫無正曜，必主生離尅害真","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936399918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"401","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"此論前数星之中，惟七殺、三方、四正、身命、夫宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"402","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱不冝見。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936399918","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"403","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"見之者，要依此斷，方可騐也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"404","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175678974967823"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"405","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"已前論賦，俱係看命要訣，學者冝熟玩之，乃得原委也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936416302","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"406","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"太微賦註觧","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936432686","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"407","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄逢冲破，吉處藏㐫；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936449070","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"408","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫逢禄存，或三合有禄，却被忌來冲防，反為㐫兆。如限步到於禄位，㐫星同聚，亦以為㐫也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"409","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬遇空亡，終身奔走，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936465454","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"410","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲生人，正截路空亡在申，傍空在酉，若安命在申，主人終身奔走，冝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"411","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"生逢敗地，發也虚花。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936481838","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"412","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如土水人安命在已為絶地，刼得金生在已，生水不絶，為母来救子之理。凢寅申巳亥為四绝，又為四生。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"413","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"星臨庙旺，再觀生尅之機；命坐強宫，細察制化之理。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936498222","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"414","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如水土生人，墓庫在辰，若與財帛同度，為財庫；與官禄同為官庫，與禄存同為天庫，耗殺同為空庫，迁移同為破。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"415","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388729868"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"416","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"庫。凢辰、戍丑未為四墓庫，此亦属纳音而論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"417","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月最嫌反背，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936514606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"418","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如日在酉戍亥子丑，月在卯辰巳午未，皆為反背，仍肴上弦、下弦。月在上弦皇日吉，下弦晦日凶。若日月同垣，便看人生時日喜、太陽月喜。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"419","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂方可論禍福；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936514606","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"420","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄馬最喜交馳，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936530990","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"421","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如甲禄在寅，而申子辰馬亦在寅，遇此得地，謂之禄馬交馳。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"422","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"空亡定要得用，天空最為𦂳要。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936547374","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"423","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫惟金空則鳴，火空則發，二限逢之，反為福論。若水空則泛，木空則折，土空則䧟，為禍矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"424","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逢敗地，専看扶持之曜，大有竒功。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936563758","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"425","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命在敗绝地，又禄存化禄扶持反羙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"426","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175678975098895"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"427","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲天府，全依輔弼之功；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936580142","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"428","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命遇紫府，又得輔弼守照，終身冨貴。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"429","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺破軍，專依羊鈴之虐。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936596526","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"430","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身、命遇七殺、破軍，又㑹羊、鈴守照，有制，反可。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"431","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"諸星吉，逢㐫也吉，諸星凶，逢吉也㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936612910","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"432","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如三方身命，但吉多凶少，則㐫多吉少則㐫。仍㸔吉㐫星得垣失陷，與夫生尅制化，以定禍福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"433","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼夾帝為上品，桃花犯主為至滛。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936629294","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"434","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命紫微，與貪狼同垣，男女邪滛奸詐，巧計施机，若得輔弼夾帝，貪狼受制，則不拘此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"435","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"君臣慶㑹，才善經邦。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936645678","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"436","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫㣲守命，得天相、昌曲；天府得天同、天梁相助；紫微得夾，為君臣慶會，逢之，無不冨貴。但有金星與刑、忌、四耗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"437","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388779020"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"438","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"同度，謂之奴欺主、臣蔽君，反為禍乱命是也。湏要","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"439","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"推詳如安禄山","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936662062","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"440","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"魁鉞同行，位居台輔，禄文拱命，貴而且賢，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936678446","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"441","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如魁鉞守身命，兼得权禄昌曲吉曜來拱，無不冨貴。但有刑忌相冲，則平常。只冝僧道。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"442","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"馬頭𢃄箭，鎮禦邉疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936694830","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"443","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如午宫安命，遇有天同、貪狼、擎羊，丙、戊人逢之化吉，雖以羊刃在命以為羙論，冨貴皆可許也，只不耐乆。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"444","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑囚夾印，刑杖惟司，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936711214","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"445","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命有天相，却被羊貞夾之，主人招官，非受刑杖，終身，不能發逹只冝僧。道可免禍也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"446","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善䕃朝綱，仁慈之長。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936727598","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"447","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如机、梁二星守身命，在辰戍宫，兼化吉相助，以為冨貴，加刑忌耗殺，僧道冝之。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"448","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貴人貴郷，逢者獲禄；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936743982","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"449","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175783203373071"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"450","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命遇有貴人，又兼吉曜權禄来助，逢之無不冨貴。限遇之，亦主發福。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"451","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財居財位，遇者冨奢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936760366","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"452","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微天府，武曲居於財帛之宫，又兼化權，禄及禄存，必主冨奢。二限若逢，大主發積。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"453","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽居午，謂之日麗中天，有專權之貴，敵國之冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936776750","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"454","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐於午宫，遇有太陽庚辛生人日生時者，冨貴全羙。女人逢之，在夫益子，封贈夫人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"455","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂居子，號曰水登桂蕚，得清要之職，忠諫之材。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936793134","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"456","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假加身命坐於子官，遇有大隂，丙丁生人，夜生時者，冨貴全羙，心無私曲，有忠諫之材。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"457","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微輔弼同宫，一呼百諾。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936809518","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"458","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微守於身命，有左右同宫來扶持，冨貴終身，以為全美之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"459","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文耗居寅卯，衆水朝東，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936825902","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"460","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175730388844556"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"461","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命居寅卯，遇昌曲破軍，却有刑殺冲破，一生驚險，限歩到此，湏逢吉則平，遇㐫更不吉，終身辛苦，费心劳力。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"462","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日月守不如照，合䕃福聚，不怕㐫危。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936842286","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"463","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如日月守身命，雖會吉曜，不為全羙；如逢㐫星，定有㐫灾。如是三合於命，兼化吉以為羙。◯蔭、福即天梁、天同。如在身命逢吉，不怕㐫灾，便有刑忌不論也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"464","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪居亥子，名為泛水桃花；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936858670","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"465","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐於亥子，遇貪狼，逢吉曜，以吉論。如遇刑忌，男浪蕩，女滛娼。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"466","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑遇貪狼，號曰風流綵杖。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936875054","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"467","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如貪狼羊刃同垣，身命於寅宫，為人聦明，更主風流，若遇閑宫，則平矣。余詳之，非也。寅宫無擎羊到位，只有陀羅所值，後學要明此論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"468","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺𤎉貞同位，路上埋屍；破軍暗曜同郷，水中作塚。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936891438","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"469","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175783203536911"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"470","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命值此二星守之，加化忌耗殺，方可依此断。或在迁移宫亦然。暗曜指巨門，亦同上断。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"471","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄居奴僕，縱有官也奔馳；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936907822","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"472","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宮星平，奴僕官，又得禄存，及化權禄吉曜，以為美論，只為人多劳碌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"473","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝遇㐫徒，雖獲吉而無道。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936924206","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"474","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫㣲守於身命，遇有權禄，刑忌同位，雖吉無凶，只為人心術不正。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"475","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"帝坐命庫，則曰金轝扶御輦；臨官同文曜，號為衣錦惹天香。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936940590","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"476","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如紫微守命宫，命前有吉曜者來呼號是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"477","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":" ","charPic":{"unicode":"图","url":"https://p6-ancientlib-sign.byteimg.com/tos-cn-i-ceu0di7tn2/read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofdyqu/1-1712049828085.webp~tplv-ceu0di7tn2-presize-v1:300:q70.png?lk3s=e5c95217&x-expires=1793664000&x-signature=7azoHjFmIqYAa4NFEZq7F0mDHG8%3D","uri":"read/SDZJ0170/1/ref/1jw0gc0ofdyqu/1-1712049828085.webp","fontType":0,"components":"","variants":"","charPicId":""},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"478","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"作大權之聀，臨官同文昌曲于福德宫亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"479","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽會文昌於官禄，皇殿首班之貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936956974","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"480","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如太陽會文昌於官祿，官逢吉瞳，冨貴全美，必作宰相之聀。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"481","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"太","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"482","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂同文曲於妻宫，蟾宫折桂，文章令盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936973358","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"483","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806401937427"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"484","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"485","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂文曲同於妻官，又兼吉曜來扶限歩，又逢至此。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550936989742","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"486","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男子蟾宫折桂，女子招貴封贈。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937006126","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"487","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"祿存守於田財，則堆金積玉；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937022510","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"488","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如禄、存星守于田、財二宫，主大冨。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"489","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財䕃坐於遷移，必巨啇高賈。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937038894","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"490","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財即武曲，䕃即天梁，此二星或一化權，禄與吉星坐宫迁，必作巨移啇高賈，若加刑，忌殺凑平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"491","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"殺居絶地，天年，夭似顔囘；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937055278","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"492","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命坐寅申巳亥，逢七殺加刑忌，又值某星所絶，縦有吉曜合照，限臨則㐫矣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"493","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耗居禄位，沿途乞食。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937071662","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"494","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如耗星守官禄宫，文逢刑忌及家午戊生人，命坐午宫、","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"495","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"巳酉丑生人，命坐酉宫，亥卯未生人，命坐","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"496","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"卯宫，申子辰生","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"497","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命坐子。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"498","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937088046","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"499","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175867752169524"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"500","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪㑹旺宫，終身𣆨𥩈，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937104430","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"501","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如耗星會貪狼，守身命官禄之位，主為人貧窮，終身為𥩈盗之人。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"502","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忌暗同居命宫，疾厄困弱尫嬴，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937120814","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"503","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命宫疾厄，官逢巨門，擎羊陀羅，為人貧困軟弱，終身不旺，不能發逹。忌乃陀羅，暗乃臣門。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"504","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫星㑹於遷移，父母刑傷産室。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937137198","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"505","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如刑忌火鈴，守於迁移父毋官，必主身体軟弱殘疾，祖業破蕩，奔波劳碌之人也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"506","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"刑殺會𤎉貞於官禄，枷杻同流","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937153582","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"507","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如刑殺㢘貞，守官祿之官，流年二限到此，不為禍患，定遭刑法。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"508","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官府夾刑殺於迁移，離郷遭配，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937169966","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"509","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如𣴑年官府與當生官府夾刑殺於迁移之宮，太嵗小限行到此，必遭刑貶配離祖之論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"510","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402002963"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"511","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"善福守於空位，天竺生涯。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937186350","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"512","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假加身命坐於空位，乃本宫無星辰也。天机天同。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"513","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三合照","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937202734","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"514","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"必主僧道，逢吉福厚，遇㐫奔波。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"515","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"輔弼單坐命宫，離宗庶出","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937219118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"516","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命無正曜，更有左右守昭，必難為父毋自小。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"517","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"離宗；","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937219118","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"518","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"偏房庶出之羙為是，如左右单守，在命宫亦然。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"519","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺臨於身命，逢流殺，必定死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937235502","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"520","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如命坐七殺，流年太嵗、刑、忌併臨，必主災病、官非、破財、人口死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"521","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊鈴合於命宫，遇白虎湏當刑戮。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937251886","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"522","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如羊鈴刑殺，坐守於命官流年，白虎又臨，必主","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"523","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官非破","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937268270","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"524","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財生災，定遭刑戮，又或小口死亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"525","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"官府𤼵於吉曜，流殺怕逢破軍，","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937284654","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"526","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"刑忌羊火守於身命，運限逢吉曜發財，流年太嵗逢悪曜為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"527","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175867752267828"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"528","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊鈴慿太嵗以引行，病符官府皆作禍。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937301038","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"529","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命逢羊鈴，坐守流年太嵗巡逢到此，必作禍興灾。如命宫有犯病符官府，更兼太嵗亦到，必主官非口舌。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"530","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"奏書慱士與流禄，盡長吉祥；力士将軍同青龍，主題權勢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937317422","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"531","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐宫，原有吉曜，流年又遇奏書事士，流禄将軍青龍，必主當年發福之荣。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"532","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"童子限如水上浮泡，老人限似燃燭。","logicSentenceId":"7580371550937333806","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"533","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"假如身命坐宫，原有悪曜，流年囚火，太嵗等殺又到此，皆主作禍生災。小児老人若見之，不冝也。中年人尚平和。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"534","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"補遺骨髓賦註觧","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078318107","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"535","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文曲、武曲居庙旺處，將相之材。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078334491","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"536","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"文昌亦同曲也。武曲於辰戍第一，丑未第二，文曲於子宫，為庙旺之地，卯酉次之，若逢左右，為贵格論。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"537","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右同宫，披緋衣紫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078350875","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"538","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402068499"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"539","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如辰戍安。命正月、七月生者，未安命，四月生者，丑安命。十月生者，卯亥安命，八月，十二月生者，巳酉安命，二月六月生者，如財官迁移，有左右。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"540","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"同宫不係左右同宫格。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078383643","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"541","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"𤎉貞在未并申宫，冨貴聲揚播遠名。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078400027","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"542","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"無殺，方是加殺平常。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"543","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨機酉上化吉者，便有財官也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078416411","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"544","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不終","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078432795","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"545","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"孤貧則有夀，冨貴即夭亡。若太陽坐安遷移，財官之卿化權禄，則横發有時。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"546","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"明禄暗禄，位至公卿；","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078449179","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"547","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"命有禄存，又逢化禄是也。如甲生人，命典禄存在寅，𤎉貞亦在寅化禄。又戊生人，安命在巳，貪狼化禄；丁已生人，安命在午，太隂化禄。丙已生人為貴格，丁戊生人平常，雖冨貴不乆。又庚生人，命坐申，太陽化禄；辛生人命在酉，巨門化禄，雖吉不羙之論。何也？因有巨机酉上化吉之說。又壬生人安命在亥，天梁化禄；癸生人安命在子，破軍化禄。乙。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"548","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175933443227700"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"549","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生人命在夘，天机化禄，此為明禄暗禄也。丙辛生人，安命在已酉，為僧禪教主，冨不可言。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"550","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"活禄逢迎夫子，文章冠世。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078465563","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"551","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"天子安命在子，太陽化禄在午，迁移宮是也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"552","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"西施傾國，命犯擎羊以捐軀；","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078481947","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"553","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"安命在午有羊刄，流年太嵗又巡逢，羊陀迭併，故命難逃也。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"554","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"項羽英雄，限到天空而喪國。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078498331","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"555","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"生處帝室，或刼空冲照，猶如半天折翅。刼空俱在命猶㐫，三方稍輕，只可平常度日。倘有横發、有財禄，必主䘮亡。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"556","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"定冨貴貧賤一十四等訣","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078514715","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"557","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078531099","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"558","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論夾貴格者有六：有紫府夾命，有日月夾命，有昌曲夾命，有魁鉞夾命，有左右夾命，有科權禄夾命，皆為夾貴格不貴","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078547483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"559","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402117651"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"560","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"即當大冨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078547483","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"561","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：夾名有六少人知，紫府科權昌曲冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078563867","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"562","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：夾月夾日誰能遇，魁鉞左右主貴竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078580251","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
