{"lines":[{"lineId":"563","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：夾逢左右少人知，權禄相逢世所冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078596635","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"564","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：日月两照人得此，官高爵禄鎮華夷。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078613019","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"565","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論夾敗格者有三：有刼空夾命，有火鈴夾命，有羊陀夾命。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078629403","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"566","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命嫌化忌，又𠔥此三夾者，為之夾敗。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078645787","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"567","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟禄存在命庙旺，兼有吉星，而羊陀夾者亦吉。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078662171","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"568","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：夾敗羊陀尚可強，空刼鈴星火又傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078678555","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"569","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：㐫殺更兼逢化忌，孤寒刑尅受災𣧎。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078694939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"570","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175933443342388"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"571","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論日月並明格者，財官遷移，三方守照者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078711323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"572","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如日月同居丑未宫安命者，三方無吉星合照，反為不羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078727707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"573","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子午辰戍在命身尤好","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078744091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"574","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：日月同宫會命身，男兒受職至公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078760475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"575","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更加吉曜多荣顯，冨貴聲揚播遠名。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078776859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"576","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：日月星緾丑未宫，三方無吉反為㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078793243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"577","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：此命羙中多不美，加殺生災到老窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078809627","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"578","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論太陽坐卯宮，為日照雷門格，卯宫安命，日生人合局","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078826011","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"579","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：日照雷門細審詳，書生人遇喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078842395","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"580","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更加吉曜多荣顯，冨貴雙全逺播揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078858779","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"581","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402166803"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"582","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論太隂居於亥宫，爲月朗天門格，亥宫安命，夜生人合局。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078875163","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"583","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：月朗天門福最隆，早扳仙桂歩蟾宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078891547","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"584","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：又加吉曜來相㑹，建節封侯笑語中。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078907931","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"585","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論紫府加㑹格，三合照身命是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078924315","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"586","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天樞天庫，位居一品之荣，又得暗禄逢迎，冨貴雙全之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078940699","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"587","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：天樞天庫逢，位登一品荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078957083","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"588","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：活禄并迎禄，照命至三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078973467","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"589","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論府相朝垣格，三合照身命是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551078989851","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"590","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐寅申者，上格，餘次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079006235","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"591","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：府相朝垣格最良，為官為士定荣昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079022619","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"592","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：財官衣禄雙加羙，職位高遷面帝王。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079039003","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"593","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175933443440692"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"594","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論仰面朝斗格，子午宫安命者是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079055387","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"595","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：紫微帝座是尊星，照處還湏科禄迎。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079071771","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"596","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：仰面或朝垣局内，一生順遂權貴荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079088155","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"597","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論甲第登庸格，科星在命，權星或禄來朝是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079104539","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"598","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：命宫三合及游行，不䧟科名始吉亨。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079120923","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"599","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：身命禄隨科甲第，断然金榜占魁名。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079137307","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"600","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論暗禄格：祿存逢禄主，三合照命是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079153691","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"601","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱在命宮尢妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079170075","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"602","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"爲明禄暗禄格。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079186459","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"603","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：禄合鴛鴦格最高，斯人文武必英豪。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079202843","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"604","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：堆金積玉身荣顕，爵位髙遷衣紫袍。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079219227","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"605","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175806402232339"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"606","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論對面朝斗格，子午宫逢禄存是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079235611","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"607","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：禄存對面在遷移，子午逢之利禄冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079251995","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"608","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：德合穹壌人敬重，雙金冨貴福稀竒。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079268379","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"609","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論科權禄主格","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079284763","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"610","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：禄權周勃命中逢，入相王朝賛聖功。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079301147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"611","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：迎合權星兼吉曜，魏上冨貴列三公。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079317531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"612","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論左右朝垣格","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079333915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"613","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：天星左右最高明，若在三方禄位興。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079350299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"614","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：武職高登應顕佐，文人名譽列公卿。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079366683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"615","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論𠔥文武格，文曲、武曲在身命是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079383067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"616","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176020525367330"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"617","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：格名文武少人知，遇此湏教百事通。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079399451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"618","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更值命宫無殺破，淆上荣顯是英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079415835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"619","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論文星朝命格","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079432219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"620","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：文昌文曲最荣華，值此湏生冨貴家。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079448603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"621","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更得三方祥曜拱，却如錦上又添花。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079464987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"622","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論石中隱玉格，命在子午逢巨門是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079481371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"623","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：巨門子午二宫逢，身命逢之必貴荣。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079497755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"624","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更得三方科禄拱，石中隠玉是豐隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079514139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"625","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論貪狼遇火，名爲火貴格，三合照身命是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079530523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"626","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：火遇貪狼照命宫，封侯食禄是英雄。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079546907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"627","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175937939521575"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"628","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：三方若然無㐫殺，到老應知福夀隆。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079563291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"629","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論人有無商賈之命，如人命有巨，曰紫府守照，為人安分，有仁徳耿直之心，作事無私，不行邪僻，不肯妄求，爲士為官，主有𤎉潔。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079579675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"630","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如值月貪同殺忌星，心多機関，貪財無厭，暮夜求利之軰。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079596059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"631","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：貪月同殺㑹机梁，因財計利作經啇。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079612443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"632","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：湏知暮夜無眠睡，湖海营营自走忙。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079628827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"633","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：經啇紫府遇驚羊，武曲遷移利市塲","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079645211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"634","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：殺破𤎉貞同左右，羊鈴火宿逺傳揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079661595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"635","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079677979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"636","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"人命有","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"637","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"無術藝者，寅申已亥安命，或辰戍丑未，遇有貪狼。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079677979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"638","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176020525498402"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"639","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲在命化忌加殺，必作細巧藝術之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079694363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"640","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：閑宫貪狼何生業，不是屠人湏打鐡。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079710747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"641","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：諸般巧藝更能精，性好逰畋并捕獵。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079727131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"642","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：破武未宮多巧藝，巳亥安命正相冝。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079743515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"643","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：破軍㢘貞居卯酉，細巧之人定藝可。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079759899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"644","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：天機天相命，身中帝令財星入墓宫。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079776283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"645","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：天府若居遷動位，平生定是作竒工。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079792667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"646","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論出家僧道之命，紫微居卯酉，遇刼空者，看命無正星，又兼羊火刼空化忌者，更看父毋、妻子三宫有殺者，方可断。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079809051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"647","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及寅年申月已日亥時，四正殺凑化，忌男僧道，女尼姑。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079825435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"648","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330175937939570727"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"649","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：極居卯酉遇刼空，十人之命九為僧。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079841819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"650","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：道釋岩泉皆有分，清閑幽静度平生。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079858203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"651","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：命坐空卿定出家，文星相㑹實堪誇。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079874587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"652","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：若還文曲臨身命，受䕃清閑福可嘉。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079890971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"653","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：天機七殺破梁同，羽客僧流命所逢。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079907355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"654","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：更若太陽兼帝座，伶仃孤尅命方終。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079923739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"655","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論人命内犯孤尅者，如尅妻尅子、尅父母，内犯一二，不為僧道，亦作貧賤之人。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551079940123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"656","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一㸔父毋在庙旺地，有無吉㐫星辰，如在䧟加殺化忌，必主刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325782067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"657","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第二又㸔妻妾宫，三看子女宫，庙䧟之地，有無吉凶星辰，如在䧟加殺化忌，必𩹌寡孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325798451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"658","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176020525613090"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"659","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尅論斷可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325814835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"660","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論夀夭淫蕩","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325831219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"661","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：貪狼入庙最高強，南極天同夀命長。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325847603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"662","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：北斗帝星無𢙣殺，綿上老耄衍禎祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325863987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"663","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：七殺臨身終是夭，貪狼入庙定為娼。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325880371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"664","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：若於三合相臨照，也學韓君去竊香。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325896755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"665","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又：身命两宫俱有殺，貪花恋酒禍猶深。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325913139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"666","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：平生二限來符㑹，得意之中却又沉。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325929523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"667","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論定人残疾，先看命宫星落陥，加羊陀火鈴刼空忌宿，又看疾厄宫星庙陥，吉㐫而断可也。","logicSentenceId":"7580371551325945907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大抵入命俱從寅上起，正月順数至本生月止。","logicSentenceId":"7580337533881974818","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又自人生月上起子時，逆至本生時安命，順至本生時安身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337533881991202","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如正月生子時，就在寅宫安命身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084845108","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑時逆轉丑安命，順去卯安身；寅時逆轉，子安命，順至辰安身。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084861492","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"餘宫倣此。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084877876","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又若閠正月生者，要在二月内起安身命，凢有閠月，俱要依此為例。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084894260","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音甲子歌，務要熟讀。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084910644","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"就如甲生人安命在寅，却起甲巳之年丙寅首是丙寅丁卯炉中火，就去火局尋某日生期起紫微帝主。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084927028","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如是正月初一日生者，是火局酉宫，有初一日，就","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084943412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176278257205285"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"從酉宫起紫㣲，庶無差悞。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084943412","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若錯了，則差之毫厘，失之千里矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084959796","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"順至生時便歸藏。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795084976180","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"te {"lines":[{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲子乙丑海中金，丙寅丁卯炉中火，戊辰己巳大林木，","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085025332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330176346343079971"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庚午辛未路傍土，壬申癸酉劔鋒金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085025332","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲戌乙亥山頭火，丙子丁丑澗下水，戊寅已卯城頭土，庚辰辛巳白臘金，壬午癸未楊柳木。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085041716","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲申乙酉泉中水，丙戍丁亥屋上王，戊子已丑霹靂火，庚寅辛卯松栢木，壬辰癸巳長流水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085058100","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲午乙未沙中金，丙申丁酉山下火，戊戌巳亥平地木，庚子辛丑壁上土，壬寅癸卯金泊金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085074484","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"甲辰乙巳覆灯火，丙午丁未天河水，戊申巳酉大驛土，庚戍辛亥釵釧金。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085090868","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"壬子癸丑桑柘木，甲寅乙卯大溪水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085107252","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丙辰丁巳沙中土，戊午巳未天上火，庚申辛酉石橊木，壬戍癸亥大海水。","logicSentenceId":"7580337795085123636","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"科星二限遇文昌，士子逢之姓名香。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534183988","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"僧道庶人多冨貴，百謀百遂事英揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534200372","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"1188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"化忌星水為多管之神，守身命，一生不順，招是非。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534216756","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限逢之，一年不足；大限相遇，十年悔吝。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534233140","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二限并太𡻕交臨，断然蹭蹬。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534249524","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"文人不耐乆，武人縱有官災，口舌不妨。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534265908","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖啇賈藝人，在𠙚不冝，難立脚。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534282292","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1193","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如㑹紫府、昌曲左右科。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534298676","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1194","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"權禄與忌同宫，又𠔥羊火鈴空，作事進退，横發横破，始終不得乆遠，即係發不住財是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534315060","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1195","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"一生奔波劳碌，或𢃄疾貧夭，僧道逢亦流移還俗。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534331444","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1196","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然天同在戌，化忌丁人遇吉；巨門在辰，化忌，辛人返","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534347828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1197","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330177966598717475"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1198","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534347828","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1199","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及太陽在寅卯辰巳午化忌，太隂在酉戌亥子化忌，反為福論。","logicSentenceId":"7580338560534364212","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"1200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若日月𨺻地化忌，主大㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580338561069613071","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":n {"lines":[{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"火铃星入西，加士無刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144784939","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蹈地的尅天魁、天鉞多主夫婦羙麗。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144801323","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天馬坐妻宫，必主得妻才。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144817707","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加吉星同，主貴美夫婦。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144834091","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"斗君過度在妻宫，逢吉星，妻妾羙益災尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144850475","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"逢惡星，主妻妾有","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144866859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178226632933385"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"災。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144866859","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看人本命妻宫，若尅妻者，的主其年刑傷；妻妾若不尅者，只斷其年有災。","logicSentenceId":"7580334957144883243","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凢看子女，先看本宫星宿，主有幾子；若加羊陀、火鈴，空刼耗忌，主生子女有刑尅。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986781995049","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次看對宫有冲刑否。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782011433","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如本宫無星曜，專看對宫有何星宿，主有幾子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782027817","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若善星貴星守子女宫，必主其人生子昌盛貴題。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782044201","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𢙣星又同刑殺守子女宫，不見刑尅，主生強横破蕩之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782060585","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看三方四正，得南斗星多，主多生男，北斗星以主多生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782076969","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若太陽落在陽宫，主先生男；太隂落在隂宫，主先生女。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782093353","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"專看刑殺守本宫，無制化相生，","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782109737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178226633015305"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"必然絶祀。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782109737","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"日生最怕太隂臨，夜生最怕太陽照。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782126121","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"此星若在児女宫，教君到老無児呌。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782142505","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫㣲庙旺男三女二加左右，昌曲有五人，加羊陀，火鈴空刼只一㕠。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782158889","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"不然偏室生者多，或招祀子居長。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782175273","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍同三人，天府同，加吉星，四五人，加昌曲左右，有貴子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782191657","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若獨守，𠕂加空刼，為孤君。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782208041","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天机庙旺，二人或庶生多。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782224425","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"176","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門同一人，天梁同在寅宫，有二三人在申宫，女多男少，只可一子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782240809","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"177","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂同二三人，加羊陀火鈴，空刼全無子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782257193","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"178","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178226633080841"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"179","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽入庙，男三女二，晚子貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782273577","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"180","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門同三人，太隂同，五人陥地。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782289961","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"181","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三子不成噐，𠕂加羊佗、火鈐空刼，止晋一子送終。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782306345","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"182","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"武曲主一子，或側室，生者多。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782322729","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"183","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"破軍同，主刑，止有一人，加羊陀、火鈴，空刼，絶祀。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782339113","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"184","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"貪狼同晚招二子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782355497","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"185","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天相同，先招外子，後親生一子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782371881","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"186","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"七殺同，主孤，或傷殘之子。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782388265","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"187","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天同庙旺，五子有貴。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782404649","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"188","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"巨門同三人，太隂同五人，在午宫陥地。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782421033","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"189","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"减半天梁同，先女後男。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782437417","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"190","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有二子，守在申宫，只可晋一子送終。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782453801","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"191","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"在寅宫加吉星。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782470185","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"192","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"有三子，加羊陀火鈴，空刼見刑尅，子少送終。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782486569","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"200","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太隂女三男二，先女後男。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782584873","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"201","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"庙玉有貴子，䧟地减半，招軟弱之子，或虚花，不成噐。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782601257","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"202","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太陽同五人，天机同二人，天同同五人，庙地無尅，䧟宫有尅，加羊陀火鈴空刼，子少。","logicSentenceId":"7580335986782617641","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"872","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左輔獨守無刑，𤎉貞同早刑，加文昌相生無刑，加羊陀火鈴，刑傷退祖，二姓延生。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688620086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"873","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右弼獨守無刑，加吉星，得父母庇䕃。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688636470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"874","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"見羊陀火鈴凑離祖，二姓安居。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688652854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"875","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"禄存無尅，加空刼。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688669238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"876","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀火鈴，早年有破父財，且刑傷，中末自成家計。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688685622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"877","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊刑尅早，㑹日月重重退祖，加吉星衆免刑。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688702006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"878","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陀羅㓜年刑傷，㑹日月重重退祖，二姓安居，加吉星入贅過房，或重拜二姓延生。","logicSentenceId":"7580335987688718390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"先㸔身命祿馬，不落空亡，天空、截空最緊，旬空次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680864831","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"第一看命主吉㐫庙旺，化吉化忌生尅；次看身主吉㐫生尅，三看遷移、財帛、官祿三方星辰刑冲尅破；四看福徳宫權禄刼空庙陷，以福徳對財帛宫也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680881215","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身命遷移、財官、福徳六宫，名曰八座，俱在庙旺，聚吉化吉，富貴高壽。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680897599","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"六宫俱陥，聚㐫化忌，夭壽貧孤。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680913983","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若卯酉時生人者尤緊。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680930367","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"外有田宅疾厄，已録于后。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680946751","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看父母妻子三宫俱有刼空殺忌，則僧之命，否則孤獨貧窮。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680963135","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命宫無正曜者，財官二宫有吉星拱照，富貴","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680979519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552036386"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"全羙；或偏房庶母所生，三方有𢙣星冲照，或二姓可延生離祖，可保成家。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680979519","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命官有正曜吉星，庙旺化吉，三方又有吉宿㑹合，上上之命；如無正曜吉星，三方有吉，上次之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898680995903","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命宮星辰無吉無凶，或吉凶相半者，如三方亦有中等星辰，為中格。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681012287","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及命宫星辰入庙旺，三方有悪星守照破格，及命星陥背，加羊火化忌，却得十干禄元來相守化吉，亦為中等之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681028671","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若命無吉星，返有凶殺化忌，無禄落陷，為下格之命。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681045055","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"三方有吉星，亦可為中等，先小後大，不能乆逺，終為成敗夭折論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681061439","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若安命星緾陥地，又加㐫殺化忌，三方又㑹羊陀火鈴空刼，為下格，貧賤二姓延生，奴僕之命，否則夭","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681077823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178794898358326"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拆六畜之命","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681077823","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論人命入格","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命入格，庙旺聚吉，科權禄守上上之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681094207","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不入庙，加吉化吉科權禄上次之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681110591","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命不入庙，不加吉，平常命入庙不加吉，中等若居陷地，又加殺化忌，為下格之命，不以入格而論也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681126975","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又入格不化吉而化㐫，只以本命吉㐫多寡而断之。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681143359","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論格星数髙下","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫府與数相合何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681159743","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微南北斗中天帝王，天府乃南斗主，又有隂陽相半者。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681176127","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若隂陽不相半，又数不相生，為下格，隂陽純一為中格，又三方四正皆吉星為上格；吉㐫相半守","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681192511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552151074"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"照為中格，純是𢙣殺，為下格，㐫徒論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681192511","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡星得上格而数得上格為第一，人臣星得上格而数得中格，為第二，位至三公；星得上格而数得下格，爲第三，位至六卿，皆為上格。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681208895","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上夀之人，星得中格而数得上格為第四，位至監司，星中数中為第五，位至縣令，星中数下為第六。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681225279","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"異路前程、貴題，皆為中等享福之人也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681241663","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又星得下格而数得上格為第七，衣禄豐足，富比陶朱，子孫蕃盛，壽享遐齡，以星雖㐫，而又入格合局故也耳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681258047","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"否虚名虚利，星下数中為第八，衣食無𧇊，星下数下為第九。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681274431","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"辛苦奔波，貧窮夭折。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681290815","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"上中下三等，依理而断也，則上可以知祖宗之源流，下可以知子孫之昌盛。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681307199","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400318518"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論人性格何如","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如身命一星緊一星。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681323583","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"緩則禀性不常，喜怒不一，善悪隨風，逐波若善星，守命則賦。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681339967","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"性仁慈公直，㐫殺守命，禀性悪虐狂妄。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681356351","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看金木水火土生尅制化推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681372735","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男女命不同，星辰各别。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681389119","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"男命先看身命，次看財帛、官禄、遷移，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"俱要庙旺為吉，敗陷聚。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"㐫為㐫，三看福徳、權禄、刼空庙陷、","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"言忌外看田宅妻。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"妾疾厄宫，吉㐫已録。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681405503","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"干後，又看父母妻","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681421887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子三宫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"俱有刼空殺忌，則僧道之命，否則貧窮孤獨。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681421887","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏要仔細𠫵詳，方可断人禍福荣枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681438271","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178972552265762"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"女命先爲身命吉㐫。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如貪狼七殺擎羊則不羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681454655","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次看福徳，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681471039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"宫吉㐫若七殺单。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"居福徳，必為娼婢，三㸔夫君，四看子媳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681471039","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"財帛、田宅。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若桃花刑殺，要敗絕空亡為吉，若諸吉廟旺，不","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681487423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"佳雖。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"是艱辛貧困，亦不為下賤夭拆。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681487423","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"67","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"論女因夫貴女命貴格，","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681503807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"68","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"反無。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"69","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"用以子媳夫君福徳為正強，田宅財帛為次強，以官禄遷移七宫為𨺻。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681503807","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"71","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"小児愽士、力士上","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"72","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"短下長，靑龍將軍，腮小頭圓，大耗鼻仰唇縮，死符病符，声髙性雄；官府奏書逢𢙣曜，落地無聲；白虎大嵗遇七殺，防弱遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681520191","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"73","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏分生尅制化之垣，更㸔帝禄盛","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681536575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"74","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400760886"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"75","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"衰之地，復觀関殺，方知壽天窮通。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681536575","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"88","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人生子亥二時，最難定凖，要仔細推詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681700415","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"89","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如子時有十刻，上五刻属昨夜亥時，下五刻属今日子時。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681716799","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"90","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天氣隂雨之際，必湏羅經以定真確時候，若差訛，則命不凖矣。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681733183","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"91","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論小児尅親","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"92","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰戌丑未生人，見辰戌丑未時最毒。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681749567","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"93","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330178992400842806"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"94","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681765951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"95","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"子寅卯巳生人，見午、申。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"96","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"酉亥時，主先尅父，出十六歲不論。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681765951","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"97","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如辰、已丑末生人，見子午卯、巳亥申酉生時者，主先尅母。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681782335","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"98","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論命先貧後富","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"99","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如人生於冨貴之家，一生快樂享福，財官題逹，妻荣子貴，奴僕成行，聲名昭著。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681798719","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"100","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"其間有半途遭傷，人離財散，官非火盗。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681815103","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"101","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身喪家亡，此等之命，非命也，却是限歩逢㐫，大小二限及太嵗相冲照，又加㐫殺守臨，故此破敗不貧，即損壽也，所謂先成後敗，先大後小也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681831487","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"102","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又有人命出身微賤，营活生理，百工巧藝，九流醫術，又為","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"103","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"農圃等軰","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"104","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"初歷艱辛度日，却乃中末平地，升騰發財，驚駭","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"105","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179103183798307"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"106","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"郷邦，因生在中庸之局，後因限歩相扶，星辰逢吉曜庙旺，以此突然發達進禄，所謂先貧後冨，先小後大是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681847871","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"107","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論大限十年祸福何如？","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"108","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"宫分星緾全吉，庙旺得地，無擎羊陀羅、火鈴空刼者，主十年安静，人財全羙。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681864255","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"109","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若限内有擎羊、陀羅、火鈴、空刼忌星為伴，成敗不一。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681880639","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"110","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宫分星緾䧟，地值擎陀、火鈴、空刼忌，又加流年𢙣殺凑合，及小限巡逢㐫殺，則官災，死亡立見。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681897023","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"111","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"大限将出，有吉星，衆者無災悔，少者災多，損人，破財不利。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681913407","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"112","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡行至寅申巳亥子午宫，遇紫微、天府、天同、太陽、大隂、昌曲、禄存、禄主吉星，主吉星，主人財興旺，添丁進口之慶。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681929791","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"113","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行至辰戍","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681946175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"114","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985140775"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"115","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑未卯酉，遇𢙣殺、𤎉貞、天使、羊陀、火鈴、空刼忌星，主人酒色荒迷，貧乏死生。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681946175","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"116","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"遇左右昌曲，仕宦遷官加職，士民生子發財，婦人喜事，僧道亦利，商賈得益。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681962559","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"117","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"凡大小二限及大嵗怕行天傷、天使夾地，怕行天空、地刼之地，怕行擎羊、陀羅之地，及羊陀冲照，怕脫㐫限，怕逢㐫限，又怕傷使、刼空、羊陀，併夾歲限。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681978943","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"118","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如天傷在子，天使在寅，嵗限在丑宫，乃併夾也。","logicSentenceId":"7580380898681995327","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"119","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"羊陀命尚且無用，况夾限乎？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106721334","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"120","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若逃得過，湏看夀星、紫微、天同、天梁、貪狼坐命可觧。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106737718","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"121","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"更湏看月值𢙣殺，日值惡殺，加凑大小嵗月日時五者叅詳吉㐫推断，","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106754102","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"122","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗行至奏書将。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106770486","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"123","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"軍直符、天使、天傷、羊陀、火鈴、空刼忌星逢一二位，主人離","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106786870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"124","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179200889946127"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"125","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財散，疾病、哭泣之兆。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106786870","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"126","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若嵗限犯重月日一二位，又逢忌星合者，官吏遭謫，常人招橫事，婦人損胎，病者死亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106803254","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"127","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若𢙣殺在不得地，如風雨暴過。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106819638","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"128","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"若歲限臨無吉星，命中無故，其年難過，必死。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106836022","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"129","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論二限太嵗吉㐫","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"130","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"湏詳大限獨守，吉㐫何如，小限獨守，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106852406","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"131","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗獨守，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106868790","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"132","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"歲限俱㐫則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106885174","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"133","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看大限與小限相逢，吉㐫何如。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106901558","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"134","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太限逢太嵗，吉㐫何如？","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106917942","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"135","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限逢太嵗，吉㐫何如，禍福尢𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106934326","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"136","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又看太歲冲大限、小限，太嵗冲羊陀七殺，然後可断夀夭荣枯。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106950710","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"137","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985239079"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"138","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論行限分南北斗","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"139","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"陽男隂女，南斗為福；隂男陽女，北斗為福。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106967094","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"140","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"北斗諸星吉㐫，大限断上五年應，小限断上半年應。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106983478","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"141","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"南斗諸星吉㐫，大限断下五年應，小限斷下半年應。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736106999862","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"142","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論流年太嵗逢吉㐫星殺","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"144","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗在命宫行，看禍福尤𦂳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107032630","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"145","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命在子宫，太嵗到子，又癸生人，逢吉則吉，遇㐫則㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107049014","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"146","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論隂隲延夀","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"147","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"隂隲延夀生百福，雖然倒限不遭傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107065398","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"148","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如有人大小二限及","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107081782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"149","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179200890109967"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"150","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"太嵗到㐫陥地，有延過壽去不死者，還是其人曾行隂隲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107081782","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"151","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"平曰利物濟人，反身修徳，以作善降祥，雖㐫不害。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107098166","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"152","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如宋郊編荻橋渡蟻是也。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107114550","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"153","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"又如諸葛亮火燒藤甲軍，傷人太毒，减夀一紀，當以此𠫵詳。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107130934","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"154","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論羊陀迭併","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"155","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如庚生人，命在卯宫，遷移在酉宫，如遇羊陀流年，亦庚禄居申，流羊在酉，流陀在未，是命在卯宮，原有酉宫擎羊冲合流年，又遇流羊流陀，謂之羊陀迭併","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107147318","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"156","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論七殺重逢","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"157","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如命中三合原有七殺守照，而流年又遇流羊、流陀冲照，謂","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107163702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"158","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179141985320999"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"159","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"之七殺重逢，二者為禍最毒，入庙災晦减輕。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107163702","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"160","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"如𨺻地逢忌，及卯酉遇擎羊，為閑宫，午生人不利也。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107180086","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"161","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"然七殺逢吉曜，衆亦轉㐫化吉，不可一槩論㐫。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107196470","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"162","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"擎羊、陀羅、七殺，逢紫微天相、禄存三合拱照，可觧","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107212854","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"163","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"詩：羊陀迭併命難逃，七殺重逢禍必遭。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107229238","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"164","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"曰：太嵗二限臨此地，十生九死不堅牢。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107245622","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"165","lineNum":0,"lineType":10,"content":"論大小二限星辰過十二宫遇十二夫人所忌訣","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"166","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"遇此主災悔，官非孝服，火盗破財，刑傷，死亡立見。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"167","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"人生子命忌寅申，假如子年生人，切忌寅申嵗限，災悔至重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107262006","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"168","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"及忌子午嵗限","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107278390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"169","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330179292686499855"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"170","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107278390","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"171","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"丑午生人丑午嗔。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107294774","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"172","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如丑生人忌午丑嵗限，午生人亦忌丑午歲限，及忌七殺星，災悔極重。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107311158","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"173","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅卯之人防已亥，假如寅卯人忌己亥嵗限，及忌卯酉寅申相冲。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107327542","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"174","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蛇龍切忌本身臨。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107343926","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"175","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"假如巳生人忌逢已年，及忌行到巳限；辰生人忌行辰年，及忌行到辰限為天羅文忌到戍爲地綱限，遇此主灾殃水厄之險，官非破財，憂制連連。","logicSentenceId":"7580381736107360310","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"886","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"三夾命㐫，六夾吉。三夾是刼空、火鈴、羊陀是也。六夾是紫府左右昌、曲、魁、鉞、科、權、禄、日月命是㐫多吉少，雖吉也在也㐫，吉多㐫少。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"887","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"雖㐫也吉，身命三方，仍看庙旺。","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319365695","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"908","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"納音墓庫，看何宫，","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319529535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"909","lineNum":0,"lineType":2,"content":"如水生人庫辰，遇財官或禄存尤妙。遇遷移耗殺同不美，生逢敗地，發也虚花。如年納音水土長生居申，申乃金星，為本宫之主，若安命在耗殺酉敗地，又羊同不美。","logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"910","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得禄存吉","logicSentenceId":"7580381859319529535","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"4","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"紫微守命，坐寅方，天府同宫最妙。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700044976147","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"5","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"左右昌曲合，加㑹两相幇，七殺朝拱，掌握威揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700044992531","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"6","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"寅午戌合，星斗明朗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045008915","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"7","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"再詳命主某星循良，夀元乘旺，富夀無疆，台輔暗拱，景星鳯凰。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045025299","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"8","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天門月照，声價琳瑯。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045041683","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"9","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"光射斗牛，普照四方。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045058067","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"10","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身星坐某，福履康荘，五行無尅，藍玉生光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045074451","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"11","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注人現瑋，邦家柱梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045090835","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"12","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"佳人破軍，重卜坤裳。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045107219","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"13","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"四宫坐貴，三杰傳芳。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045123603","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"14","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"茲行某限，吉星之郷，名登仕籍，日出扶桑，峥嵘頭角，烏帽錦裳，双南溢笥，九粟盈倉。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045139987","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"15","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"維皇眷徳，福壽陵崗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045156371","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"16","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"蟾從觸後，愈暢輝光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045172755","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"17","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"耒春某月，左輔文昌，化科","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045189139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"18","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181976298848308"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"19","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"得令，政績著揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045189139","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"20","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年某星，夜雨消湘，財丁損抑，骨肉参啇，愬匕終吉，視履考祥。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045205523","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"21","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"喬遷某限，彩鳯翶翔，出司郡佐，報績聖皇，希踪卓魯，接武龔黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045221907","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"22","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部院綵徼，交馳旌揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045238291","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"23","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"名崇五岳，利湧三湘。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045254675","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"24","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"肖嗣脫頴，蘭吐天香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045271059","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"25","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限逢陀，尤見剥床。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045287443","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"26","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某星救護，意兹蕭墻。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045303827","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"27","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"秗風乍起，蓴鱸味香，逢冠高掛，荣旋錦堂。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045320211","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"28","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"十年某限，福夀寧康，重裀列𪔂，冠盖鏘匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045336595","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"29","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"天夀星輔，愈熾愈昌。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045352979","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"30","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"垂封之祝，嘖匕道傍。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045369363","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"31","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"惟到某星，雲掩無光，梁木其壊，哲人云亡。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045385747","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
{"lines":[{"lineId":"32","lineNum":0,"lineType":9,"content":"又","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045402131","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}

{"lines":[{"lineId":"33","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"命坐午垣，巨門石中，隠玉明彰，逢生無尅，理𠫭詳三方四正，","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045418515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"34","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181603253223465"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"35","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"吉，福夀等陵崗。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045418515","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"36","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"右弼歸垣互守，化權，掌楃鏗鏘。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045434899","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"37","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"身宫魁鉞拱，貴格豈尋常。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045451283","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"38","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"注人丰神卓偉，表匕景星鳯凰，胸懷今右冨琳瑯。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045467667","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"39","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"功名應有待，何必恁惶。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045484051","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"40","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"匕。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045500435","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"41","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"次究星命：某星逢得地，高強，竒哉。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045516819","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"42","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"金水會蛇卿，文昌文曲畫光芒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045533203","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"43","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"加㑹得照合，定擬發科。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045549587","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"44","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"傷官福二宫星美，生平作事端荘，身居奴僕静中。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045565971","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"45","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"忙妻宫逢七殺，正副免刑傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045582355","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"46","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"児宫擎羊作踐，先虚後實飛黃。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045598739","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"47","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"現今限步正輝光。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045615123","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"48","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"早奪焚舟計，雷劍吐光芒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045631507","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"49","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"小限恩光台輔，文宗取試名揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045647891","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"50","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"觀塲補廪喜洋匕流昌曲星集，誰識一穿揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045664275","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"51","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限行耒題逹，中年貪武為良，門庭生色喜非常。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045680659","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"52","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"財源春水漲，志氣吐眉揚。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045697043","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"53","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年忌某星，冝慎内外憂傷。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045713427","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"54","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"亦","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045729811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"55","lineNum":0,"lineType":3,"content":"","pagePass":{"PageId":"7330181976298913844"},"logicSentenceId":"0","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"56","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"冝懲忿恣，親善逺奸狂。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045729811","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"57","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限交来匕殺紫微制伏禎祥，巍然超拔声名香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045746195","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"58","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"拜官居百里，徳政嫓襲黄。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045762579","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"59","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年有所畏忌，湏知到此驚慌。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045778963","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"60","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"尚喜某星為福，依然福履無疆。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045795347","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"61","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"行交某限，十年康。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045811731","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"62","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"部院馳綵撽，黔庻植甘棠。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045828115","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"63","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某限桑榆暮景，東籬陶菊金黃，篿鱸羙味逕三荒。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045844499","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"64","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"二䟽從斛組，看子紹書香。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045860883","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"65","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"某年某星為忤，某星相黨相戕，俄然一夣熟黄梁。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045877267","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null},{"lineId":"66","lineNum":0,"lineType":1,"content":"哲人其蒌矣，空為裂肝腸。","logicSentenceId":"7580322700045893651","marginNoteIdList":null,"pinYin":null}],"indent":0,"textIndent":false}
